b53ff4e5-1364-4cac-bdf2-c7cb8845717f.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
b53ff4e5-1364-4cac-bdf2-c7cb8845717f.description: Why Rubie At Rubie, we help high‑growth companies migrate their customer data autonomously so they can onboard customers in hours instead of weeks. ERPs, CRMs, and other systems‑of‑record are painful to set up because ingesting, mapping, and cleaning legacy data is still mostly manual. Rubie unblocks customer‑success teams by combining agentic infrastructure, AI‑assisted transformation, and a relentless bias‑to‑action. We’re moving a lot of data and backed by top‑tier investors (Afore Capital, Crossbeam Ventures, Earl Grey Ventures, Comma Capital). Big technical challenges and real customer pain - and we need people who love both. We are growing fast, with extremely strong retention, and we need to scale the post-sales team to ensure our customers have fast and friction-less onboarding, deploy Rubie beyond the initial use cases and expand their usage; while remaining raving fans! The Role You are Rubie’s face/tip of the spear for our customers. During early roll‑outs you sit inside their problem space and make sure they win. Once we sign up new customers, they'll be handed over to you to oversee their onboarding and integration. You will need to: Manage stakeholders and timelines to ensure quick adoption. Provide technical feedback to the engineering team on potential issues or bottlenecks Design and build custom data migration playbooks (coding not required, but understanding of data models and comfort with data manipulation is a must) Anticipate any new needs, expansion or challenges Day‑to‑day you will: Guarantee 100% retention: You own the metric. Whatever it takes. Dive into datasets: make sense of them, manipulate them, map them. You need to be as comfortable with unstructured data as you are with VLOOKUPs on massive datasets Design and execute playbooks: Use our platform to create data migration playbooks and use every tool at your disposal to unblock weird edge cases. Operate in the field: Pair with product and engineering; jump on calls; debug live; be willing to hop on a plane when needed; communicate clearly under pressure. Feed the roadmap : Translate frontline chaos into crisp product requirements and implementation guides for the core engineering team. Tackle “impossible” projects : When a customer’s need looks hopeless, you volunteer first, and then deliver. Be the primary point of contact for high-stakes customers: from non-technical ops teams living in spreadsheets to deeply technical stakeholders, often under real time pressure (live migrations, sales deadlines, post-acquisition cleanups), where data accuracy and clear communication are non-negotiable. We are a product-first company, you are our customers’ ally to materialize the vision. About You Hungry scrappy: You like hard problems, long hours, and tangible impact. Glass‑chewer: Ambiguity and gnarly data sets energize you. You know what the mission is and that we’ll get you where you want to be Technical literacy: Comfortable using AI to write quick scripts, wrangle APIs, and dissecting data requirements. Even better if you’ve been a software engineer in a past role. Technical literacy: At least 1 year of software development experience. Languages are not important, but you must be comfortable writing and modifying scripts, debugging technical and data-related customer issues, reasoning about APIs and data models, and dissecting ambiguous data requirements. Customer‑obsessed communicator : You can translate between business, ops, and engineering in real time. High‑ownership operator: You run toward fires and stay until they’re out. NYC‑based (or willing to relocate): You believe speed and trust compound in person. If you’ve worn any of these hats before - onboarding engineer, implementation engineer, forward‑deployed engineer, solutions architect, or solutions engineer - you’ll ramp fast. Compensation Benefits Competitive salary + meaningful equity. Everyone at Rubie is an owner. Premium health, dental, and vision coverage. 5‑day‑a‑week in‑office culture in Union Square, NYC Relocation assistance for the right candidate. The chance to build category‑defining tech and wealth at the same time. FAQ: What's the required experience level? We're open to earlier career candidates (including new grads) who can prove that you are ready to hustle and learn quickly Can I be remote for this role? No, we are an in person team in New﻿ York City 5 days a week Do I need to know how to write code? No, but if a task at hand calls for it then we'll expect you use LLMs and our engineering team to hack together a solution to your problem (That said - if you do know how to code, that's definitely a plus!) What’s the interview process We move fast and also want to ensure full transparency during the process: You will talk with one of our leaders first Next step: group interview for 60min where we will go over the day to day, past experiences and our values - this will include our founding FDE and our CEO Last step: onsite “real life” experience. We aim at providing a taste of what it’s like to work at Rubie
b53ff4e5-1364-4cac-bdf2-c7cb8845717f.fit_reason: Customer-facing implementation/solutions role where "coding not required" and success is measured by retention and stakeholder management — a poor use of a backend/distributed-systems and AI-infra profile, though NYC location, new-grad openness, and the data/API/scripting component keep it from scoring lower.
b53ff4e5-1364-4cac-bdf2-c7cb8845717f.tc_basis: Rubie is an early/seed-stage NYC startup (Afore, Crossbeam, Earl Grey, Comma) with no public comp data, so this is a wide inferred band: NYC seed-stage FDE/implementation base typically ~110-135k for an early-career hire, plus illiquid equity that adds nominal but high-variance value. Cash portion likely sits at or below the candidate's ~130k anchor; the upper end assumes a strong offer with meaningful paper equity.

d44c4b34-245b-4951-b4ec-573f93fbe2ac.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
d44c4b34-245b-4951-b4ec-573f93fbe2ac.description: ABOUT RETELL AI Retell AI is using first-principles thinking to reimagine the call center with cutting-edge voice AI. Thousands of companies now use Retell's AI voice agents to handle sales, support, and logistics calls that once required large teams of human agents. Backed by Y Combinator, Alt Capital, and other leading investors, we've scaled to $80M in ARR with a team of 50, up from $5M at the start of 2025, and are now valued at over $1.5B. Our vision for 2026 is to build a modern CX platform where entire contact centers are powered by AI. Instead of basic automation that needs constant human tuning, we're creating intelligent AI “workers” that act as frontline agents, QA analysts, and managers, continuously executing, monitoring, and improving every customer interaction. We're growing fast and looking for ambitious builders who want to tackle hard technical problems, move quickly, and have a real impact on one of the fastest-growing voice AI companies in the world. Let's build the future together. Recent recognition: No. 1 Best Places to Work in the Bay Area, San Francisco Business Times 2026 Top 50 AI Apps, a16z (2025) #3 Fastest-Growing Software Company, G2 Best Software Awards 2026 Best Agentic AI Software, G2 Best Software Awards 2026 #4 Fastest-Growing Software Vendor, Brex Benchmark 2025 Enterprise Tech 30 Class of 2026, Nasdaq Wing VC Top-Ranked Startup, Lean AI Leaderboard Backed by Y Combinator ABOUT THE ROLE We're looking for new grad builders who want to get their hands dirty and work directly with customers. As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you'll work closely with enterprise clients to build and launch voice AI solutions. You'll spend roughly 50% of your time building and 50% working directly with customers, helping understand their needs, solve problems, and get projects into production. This is a great fit for someone who has completed technical internships, has a strong interest in startups, and genuinely enjoys working with people and customers. WHAT YOU'LL DO Build and launch voice AI solutions for enterprise customers. Write production code in Python, JavaScript, or similar languages. Build integrations with CRMs, ERPs, scheduling tools, and other systems. Work directly with customers to understand their needs and solve technical problems. Partner with sales on demos, prototypes, and technical discussions. Learn Retell's platform and become an expert in building voice AI agents. Turn customer feedback into product and engineering improvements. YOU MIGHT THRIVE IF You're a recent graduate with a strong technical background. You've completed one or more software engineering, technical, or similar internships. You like building things and figuring things out on your own. You have a strong interest in startups and want to work in a fast-moving environment. You enjoy working directly with customers and explaining technical concepts. You're comfortable with ambiguity and taking ownership. You can code in Python, JavaScript, or a similar language. You're excited about AI and want to learn how to build real-world AI systems. JOB DETAILS Cash: $150k - $260k Equity: Equity Provided Location: Redwood City, CA, US (Relocation Provided) US Visas: Retell AI is open to sponsoring work authorization for qualified candidates, including H1B/H-1B, TN, L-1, E-3, F-1 (OPT/CPT), and O-1 visas. OTHER BENEFITS 100% coverage for medical, dental, and vision insurance $70/day DoorDash credit for unlimited breakfast, lunch, dinner, and snacks $200/month wellness reimbursement $300/month commuter reimbursement $75/month phone bill reimbursement $50/month internet reimbursement COMPENSATION PHILOSOPHY Best Offer Upfront: Choose from three cash-equity balance options; no negotiation needed. Top 1% Talent: Above-market pay to attract exceptional builders. High Ownership: Small teams, significant responsibility, and meaningful equity. Performance-Based: Offers tied to interview performance, not experience or past salaries. INTERVIEW PROCESS Online Assessment Recruiter Intro Call (15 min): Learn about us and share your background. Technical Phone Interview (45min) : Live practical coding Technical Phone Interview (45 min): Customer facing systems design Onsite/Virtual Interviews (2–3 hrs): Three rounds focused on communication, architecture, and problem-solving.
d44c4b34-245b-4951-b4ec-573f93fbe2ac.fit_reason: Technically strong AI-product company with real backend/integration work and top-of-market pay, but it's a 50% customer-facing forward-deployed role rather than backend/distributed-systems/infra, and the posting targets class of 2026 while the candidate graduates May 2027.
d44c4b34-245b-4951-b4ec-573f93fbe2ac.tc_basis: Posting states cash $150k–$260k plus equity; new grads typically land in the lower-to-middle of a stated band, so ~$160–200k cash plus meaningful startup equity at a $1.5B valuation. Estimate, not fact — actual offer varies with interview performance (they explicitly tie offers to interview results) and the chosen cash/equity split, and private-company equity value is speculative.

3588169e-17ec-4faf-a06f-498add51cc22.title: Junior GTM Engineer
3588169e-17ec-4faf-a06f-498add51cc22.description: Junior GTM Engineer Current Openings Junior GTM Engineer Junior GTM Engineer About Hearth Hearth is the AI growth system for local home improvement small businesses. We build revenue-critical software for home improvement contractors — the roofers, HVAC techs, and builders who keep America running. Our platform helps real business owners win more jobs, protect profit margins, and manage homeowner relationships professionally so they can build generational companies for their families and communities. We are now building the next layer: a personal AI employee for every small business in the trades focused on autonomously generating sales for America’s home improvement pros. An assistant who answers every call 24/7, qualifies leads, books appointments, follows up on quotes and estimates, and helps small business owners go from missing half of their business to capturing all of it. With 15,000+ paying customers, default profitability, and backing from some of the world’s best investors (Founder’s Fund, 8VC, Human Capital, etc.), Hearth is focused on bringing AI to the trades. The Opportunity You built something real in college. Now every job listing wants you to spend three years earning permission to matter. Skip that. Hearth is the AI growth system for local home-improvement contractors. Over 50% of these businesses go under without software like Hearth, and when you ship a system that works, a roofer stops losing 40% of his inbound calls and gets home for dinner. The loop between your work and someone's livelihood is short. We're rebuilding how a profitable, 15,000-customer company runs its revenue, with AI at the center of every motion: lead scoring in production, agents doing rep busywork, one data backbone under all of it. GTM engineering is the team doing the rebuilding, and this seat puts you on it from day one. Not shadowing, not ticket triage: real pieces of the machine, working directly with the VP of Revenue who owns the function, and your work measured against revenue from week one. You came out of school building with tools most companies are still writing policies about. What You've Done : 1. You've already built things people actually used. A side project with real users, a tool your club or internship team ran on, an agent that stayed alive after you stopped babysitting it. The degree matters less than what you shipped outside the syllabus. 2. You build with AI as the default. You live in Claude Code (or whatever's best) and use it to build things your resume alone wouldn't predict. What was prompts and personas last year is full apps now, and you moved with it. Python and SQL where they help. Show us what you shipped. 3. You're hungry. You want your work measured, you want scope faster than a title track hands it out, and feedback from people who've done this longer makes you better every week. You don't need to know Salesforce, HubSpot, or our stack. You need to close gaps in days, not months. If you want a syllabus instead of a scoreboard, this isn't the seat. Why This Role: Every company says it's becoming AI-first. Almost none let a new grad build the systems that make it true. This one does, because we'd rather bet on what you shipped than on your years. Come build the machine. We're hiring for this team at multiple levels. Apply to the listing that fits; we level the seat to the person, so if you're stronger than the title, we'll figure that out together. Location This role will be located in NYC along with the rest of the technical Hearth team, the CEO, and other key roles in the business. Hearth believes in the energy, connection, and serendipity of in-person/hybrid work culture (3+ days/week) for builders who are committed to building truly innovative software and making a significant positive impact in the world. Benefits Mission-driven, values-based culture. Competitive pay. Unmatched opportunities to learn and develop; front-row seat at a fast-growing tech startup Generous PTO, plus paid company holidays. Stock options. Medical, dental, and vision options. 401(k) Free Employee Assistance Program Parental Leave Program Pet Insurance More About Us Hearth embraces diversity. We are proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and do not discriminate on the basis of sex, race, color, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, religion, national origin, citizenship, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We consider employment for qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Hearth uses AI-assisted tools as part of our hiring process. All hiring decisions are made by a Hearth employee. Questions about our process? Contact recruiting@gethearth.com . Apply now Revenue Operations New York, NY Share on: Apply now Terms of service Privacy Cookies Powered by Rippling

d7ecad8e-2784-42de-9aa1-dace4686274a.description: January 2027 - Leap Systems Analyst Skip to main content Sign In Fidelity Careers January 2027 - Leap Systems Analyst page is loaded January 2027 - Leap Systems Analyst Apply locations Westlake, TX Durham, NC Merrimack, NH time type Full time posted on Posted 19 Days Ago job requisition id 2133868 Job Description: Fidelity Leap Program Note: Fidelity will not provide immigration sponsorship for this position Launch your tech career by building real solutions that impact millions. Ready to go beyond the classroom? Build technology that powers financial outcomes for millions of customers — supporting individuals, employers, and institutions across a global, diversified business with trillions in assets. Join Fidelity’s Leap Program and start your career alongside thousands of technologists shaping the future of financial services. About the Leap Program Our 10-week immersive program is designed to help you transition from college to a full-time technology career. You’ll gain hands-on experience, build production-ready skills, and grow alongside a cohort of peers, all while solving real, complex business challenges. What you’ll gain: Real-world technology experience from day one Mentorship from experienced engineers and leaders A strong peer network that lasts beyond the program A clear path to continued growth at Fidelity Program Highlights Learn by Building Work on real projects in a supportive environment where you can experiment, learn, and make an impact. AI-Native Development Use AI tools as part of your daily workflow, learning how to apply them responsibly to modern engineering challenges. Cohort Experience Join a group of peers in an in-person, team-based setting with built-in support, coaching, and collaboration. Career Acceleration This isn’t just a program, it’s the start of your career. Continue growing with meaningful work, mentorship, and long-term opportunities at Fidelity. Familiarity with requirements gathering, documentation, or systems analysis concepts (academic or internship experience) Foundational awareness of data concepts (e.g., data flows, data validation, or querying) Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills Ability to break down problems and ask thoughtful, clarifying questions Familiarity with diagramming tools such as Visio or Drawio Hands-on project or internship experience (preferred) Strong written and verbal communication skills Ability to collaborate and thrive in a fast-paced, team environment Curiosity, attention to detail, and a passion for continuous learning Why Fidelity? Work on systems and products used by millions Access to diverse tech stack and AI tools Structured career development and mobility Strong mentorship culture Competitive benefits and stability If you’re excited to learn how technology enables business outcomes and want to build a strong foundation in systems analysis, Fidelity is a great fit for you. We hire for fundamentals, learning agility and problem-solving, and are committed to help you grow. Apply today! a270922d-2173-4482-b7ad-d9fcc70f0b39.description: Engineer - Life Safety Security - Intertek USA Careers Skip to main content. sitemap Profile Sign Out View More Jobs Engineer - Life Safety Security Arlington Heights, IL, United States 0 --> Job Description Engineer-Life Safety Security – Arlington Heights, Illinois Intertek, a leading provider of quality and safety solutions to many of the world’s top-recognized brands and companies, is actively seeking an Engineer-Life Safety Security to join our Electrical Safety team in Arlington Heights, Illinois. This is a fantastic opportunity to grow a versatile career in facilitating international trade and regulatory product testing . Intertek's Electrical business line applies more than 100 years of product testing expertise to quickly and efficiently help clients meet safety, performance, environmental and quality requirements for every market. Spanning a wide range of industries such as Medical, Lighting, Renewable Energy, HVACR, Appliances Electronics, Hazardous Locations, Industrial Equipment, Life Safety Security, IT Telecom Equipment, Intertek's global network of laboratories employ world-class experts in their fields who deliver quality, accurate testing and certification that continually exceeds our clients' expectations and helps to clear a path for their product's success. Intertek is continually innovating and evolving to reduce risk for consumers, brands and organizations in every sector and industry around the world. We go beyond Testing, Inspection and Certification of products: we are a Total Quality Assurance Provider to industries worldwide. Our Purpose: Bringing quality, safety, and sustainability to life. What are we looking for? The Engineer-Life Safety Security is responsible for performing electrical testing and evaluation on a variety of products to the provisions of U.S., Canadian and other International product safety standards; writing reports; and communicating with clients. This position has the potential for 15% travel. Salary Benefits Information The base wage or salary range for this position is $70,000-$80,000. Individual compensation packages are based on a variety of factors unique to each candidate including skill set, experience, qualifications, and other job-related reasons. In addition to competitive compensation packages, when working with Intertek you can expect benefits including medical, dental, vision, life, disability, 401(k) with company match, generous vacation / sick time (PTO), tuition reimbursement and more. What you’ll do: Under the guidance of a more senior engineer, conduct on and off site evaluation of products to determine compliance with applicable standard(s). Read and determine applicability of national codes and standards clauses for the EUT (equipment under test). Read and understand schematics and manufacturing instructions. Validate the project scope and sample applicability. Under scope of the project, identify and locate test instruments and equipment required for testing. Follow established test plan. Set up and operate EUT; perform and document simple repairs on EUT as needed. Conduct thorough construction review; document results. Perform testing of products in accordance with standards. Complete preliminary design reviews (PDR) both on and off site. Develop and set up test plans. Set up and operate standard test equipment including, but not limited to, spectrum analyzer, oscilloscope, multi-meter, dielectric strength tester, ground continuity tester, digital multi-meter, surge generator, over-voltage tester, environmental condition chamber, articulated probes. Use hand tools to build/calibrate test fixtures. Following sample handling procedures, ensure that sample is logged into and out of the system. Move equipment as needed through the facility. Properly package sample for shipment. Compile test results during construction review and testing. Compile data and product description and type final report using established report shell. Submit report to reviewer for final approval. Communicate project status and test results to client, sales personnel, and management throughout testing. Provide on-going support to clients as needed. Within policy guidelines, identify, properly document, and recommend engineering judgments. Perform other work as required. This position outline is a general guideline and does not represent all encompassing details. The position assumes that the incumbent has both the mental and physical requirements to carry out the above defined duties. Minimum Requirements Qualifications: Bachelor's degree in Engineering No experience required - new grads considered Must be able to work on-site, full-time Must possess a valid unrestricted driver’s license and clean driving record Excellent verbal and written communication skills Excellent organization and time management skills Excellent customer service skills Must be self-motivated and able to work independently in a fast-paced, multi-tasking environment Ability to define problems, collect data, establish facts, and draw valid conclusions Ability to interpret an extensive variety of technical instructions in mathematical or diagram form and deal with several abstract and concrete variables Ability to make technical decisions and engineering judgments independently within established parameters Microsoft Office expertise Ability to travel as business needs dictate, up to 15% Physical dexterity/mobility to travel via car, airplane and to perform all functions inherent to the position Preferred Requirements Qualifications: Bachelor’s degree in electrical or mechanical engineering Prior project management experience Demonstrated experience with U.S., Canadian and other international product safety standards; i.e., ANSI, CSA, UL, EN, IEC Intertek: Total Quality. Assured. Intertek is a world leader in the Quality Assurance market, with a proven, high-quality business model and a global network of customer-focused operations and highly engaged subject matter experts.

e7798c65-abfa-46f3-ada4-bcd7733434a3.title: Machine Learning Scientist - Large Multimodal Models - Post-Training
e7798c65-abfa-46f3-ada4-bcd7733434a3.description: JOB SUMMARY We are seeking a Machine Learning Scientist to join the Enchant team at Iambic Therapeutics. Our mission is to deliver better medicines through innovation in AI-based discovery technologies. In this role, you will research and develop post-training methods for Enchant - our multimodal transformer model trained on a wide variety of biomedical data - pushing the boundaries of what large-scale foundation models can achieve in drug discovery. The role centers on designing and evaluating post-training approaches for large multimodal language models including supervised fine-tuning, parameter-efficient fine-tuning, reinforcement learning, preference or reward-based optimization, and other emerging post-training methods. You will develop rigorous evaluations and training infrastructure that make it possible to rapidly iterate on these approaches at scale and work closely with colleagues across machine learning, software engineering, and drug discovery to put powerful foundation models into the hands of scientists making real therapeutic decisions. We are hiring across multiple levels and welcome candidates ranging from recent PhD graduates to experienced researchers with a strong publication or deployment record. This is a remote position, with the option to be on-site in our Boston office. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Research and develop post-training strategies for large-scale multimodal foundation models Design reward functions, training objectives, data-generation strategies, and evaluation protocols for reinforcement learning and other post-training approaches applied to multimodal LLMs Build systematic experimentation and hyperparameter optimization workflows to efficiently explore post-training recipes, model configurations, and training strategies Develop and apply inference optimization techniques to support deployment in both high-throughput model evaluation and interactive discovery workflows Design and maintain rigorous benchmarking and evaluation frameworks that measure model quality across modalities, downstream tasks, and scientific use cases Collaborate with ML and software engineering colleagues to productionize models, evaluation systems, and inference services Partner with computational chemists, medicinal chemists, and biologists to ensure model development and post-training objectives are grounded in drug discovery needs Communicate results to internal teams, external partners, and at conferences Write high-quality research and engineering code: refactor, test, document, and package ML components to support team velocity QUALIFICATIONS PhD in machine learning, computer science, computational chemistry, physics, or a related computational STEM field, or equivalent industry experience demonstrating comparable depth Strong Python and PyTorch skills, including implementing, training, debugging and evaluating deep learning models end-to-end Demonstrated experience training large-scale transformer models Demonstrated experience in one or more of the following: Reinforcement learning approaches such as RLHF, RLAIF, PPO, GRPO, RL with verifiable rewards, or related methods (strongly preferred) Supervised fine-tuning, full-parameter fine-tuning, parameter-efficient fine-tuning (LoRA), or related methods Systematic hyperparameter optimization or large-scale experimentation using tools such as Optuna, Ray Tune, or similar frameworks Strong engineering practices: reproducible experimentation, clean code, testing, and performance-aware debugging Comfort with modern ML infrastructure (e.g., Docker, CUDA, Kubernetes, experiment tracking tools such as Weights Biases) PREFERRED Experience with multimodal or multi-task model architectures Training and inference optimization (e.g., mixed precision, kernel optimization, quantization, distributed strategies) Familiarity with biomedical, chemical, or biological data domains Distributed training at scale HPC or large-scale training operations experience ABOUT IAMBIC THERAPEUTICS Iambic is a clinical-stage life-science and technology company developing novel medicines using its AI-driven discovery and development platform. Based in San Diego and founded in 2020, Iambic has assembled a world-class team that unites pioneering AI experts and experienced drug hunters. The Iambic platform has demonstrated delivery of new drug candidates to human clinical trials with unprecedented speed and across multiple target classes and mechanisms of action. Iambic is advancing a pipeline of potential best-in-class and first-in-class clinical assets, both internally and in partnership, to address urgent unmet patient need. Learn more about the Iambic team, platform, pipeline, and partnerships at iambic.ai . MISSION CORE VALUES Our mission is to deliver better medicines through innovations in AI-based discovery technologies. The culture and work at Iambic Therapeutics are profoundly strengthened by the diversity of our people and our differences in background, culture, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, and life experiences. We are committed to building an inclusive environment where a diverse group of talented humans work together to discover therapeutics and create technologies. PAY AND BENEFITS We offer industry leading competitive pay, company paid healthcare, flexible spending accounts, voluntary life insurance, 401K matching, and uncapped vacation to our team. We are in a brand-new state-of-the art facility in beautiful San Diego with an onsite gym, dining, and easy access to great places to live and play.

a982372c-9240-4017-912e-f077c131bd45.title: Material Response Modeling Engineer
a982372c-9240-4017-912e-f077c131bd45.description: Material Response Modeling Engineer Skip to main content Careers Sign In Home Search for Jobs Material Response Modeling Engineer page is loaded Material Response Modeling Engineer Apply locations Mountain View, CA time type Full time posted on Posted 6 Days Ago job requisition id R-100744 Job Description: Position Overview Analytical Mechanics Associates (AMA) is seeking a highly motivated Material Response Modeling Engineer to support NASA under the Aircraft Systems and Spaceflight Engineering Support Services (ASSESS) contract at NASA Ames Research Center (ARC) in Moffett Field, California. The selected candidate will work on-site within the Thermal Protection Materials (TSM) Branch, part of the Entry Systems and Technology Division at NASA ARC. This position supports the development, application, verification, and validation of computational tools for predicting the response of thermal protection system (TPS) materials in extreme aerothermal environments. The successful candidate will work as part of an interdisciplinary team of computational and experimental researchers to advance material-response modeling capabilities, support development of advanced TPS materials, and improve the predictive fidelity and computational performance of engineering simulation tools. This opportunity is open to U.S. citizen and legal permanent resident candidates ranging from recent M.S. or Ph.D. graduates through experienced technical contributors and senior researchers. A Ph.D. is preferred but not required; applicants with an M.S. and strong relevant experience are encouraged to apply. 1ea3eee5-9e41-4423-bc32-566742b27aea.title: Software Engineer - Robotics - Motion
1ea3eee5-9e41-4423-bc32-566742b27aea.description: Company Overview ACS (Allen Control Systems) is a defense technology company building precision robotic systems for the United States and its allies. Founded by two former U.S. Navy electrical engineers with deep experience in robotics and software, ACS brings together AI, computer vision, precision motion, and advanced hardware to solve complex defense challenges across land, air, and maritime environments. Our flagship product, Bullfrog, is an autonomous precision weapon system that transforms existing weapons into highly accurate counter-drone systems — giving warfighters a scalable, cost-effective response to one of the fastest-growing threats on the modern battlefield. Bullfrog is deployed with U.S. forces, and ACS works with organizations throughout the U.S. military and national security community. Following a $200 million Series B at a $2.2 billion valuation, ACS is rapidly expanding manufacturing, accelerating Bullfrog deployments, and developing the next generation of autonomous battlefield systems. This is an opportunity to join a proven, fast-moving team and help scale technology with direct, real-world impact on national security. ACS is headquartered in Austin, Texas, with additional operations in Alexandria, Virginia; Mountain View, California; and Huntsville, Alabama. For more information, visit allencontrolsystems.com . Position Overview We are seeking a Software Engineer with a speciality in Robotics. In this position you will be responsible for turning computer vision output into precise, safe motion — running real-time control loops, and getting the turret pointed exactly where we want it, when we want it. We’re hiring across multiple experience levels, including: Associate Software Engineer. Software Engineer. Senior Software Engineer. Staff Software Engineer. Senior Staff Software Engineer. Your title and level will be determined based on your experience, skills, and the scope of responsibility appropriate for the role. What You'll Do: Control robot motion to track drones under tight real-time constraints. Develop and tune real-time control loops for accurate, stable pointing. Own calibration routines and coordinate-frame transforms across the sensor/actuator chain. Define and negotiate a robust software/hardware contract at the actuation handoff, minimizing rework. Enforce safety constraints on motion (limits, no-fire zones, fault handling) as a first-class design concern. What You'll Need : Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field. Strong proficiency in C++ for real-time/deterministic code; Python for tooling and analysis. Solid grounding in linear algebra, kinematics, and coordinate transforms. Experience with real-time or low-latency systems and performance optimization. Control theory fundamentals (PID and beyond). You'll Stand Out: Robotics frameworks (ROS/ROS 2) and Eigen. Advanced control (MPC, LQR, state estimation / Kalman filtering). Motor / servo / actuator control and sensor calibration. Real-time Linux, deterministic scheduling, or safety-critical systems experience. What We Offer: Competitive salary ACS Equity Package Health, Dental, Vision Insurance Paid Time Off Allen Control Systems is an Equal Opportunity Employer, providing equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment. Allen Control Systems prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.

c2eb777c-07d3-435c-84fa-0952b2f9993a.description: Company Overview ACS (Allen Control Systems) is a defense technology company building precision robotic systems for the United States and its allies. Founded by two former U.S. Navy electrical engineers with deep experience in robotics and software, ACS brings together AI, computer vision, precision motion, and advanced hardware to solve complex defense challenges across land, air, and maritime environments. Our flagship product, Bullfrog, is an autonomous precision weapon system that transforms existing weapons into highly accurate counter-drone systems — giving warfighters a scalable, cost-effective response to one of the fastest-growing threats on the modern battlefield. Bullfrog is deployed with U.S. forces, and ACS works with organizations throughout the U.S. military and national security community. Following a $200 million Series B at a $2.2 billion valuation, ACS is rapidly expanding manufacturing, accelerating Bullfrog deployments, and developing the next generation of autonomous battlefield systems. This is an opportunity to join a proven, fast-moving team and help scale technology with direct, real-world impact on national security. ACS is headquartered in Austin, Texas, with additional operations in Alexandria, Virginia; Mountain View, California; and Huntsville, Alabama. For more information, visit allencontrolsystems.com . Position Overview: We are seeking a highly skilled Robotics Software Engineer, very proficient in C++ or Python coding. We are hiring across multiple experience levels, including: Associate Software Engineer Software Engineer Senior Software Engineer Staff Software Engineer Senior Staff Software Engineer Please note that your title and level will be determined based on your experience, skills, and the scope of responsibility appropriate for the role. What You'll Do: Design, develop, and maintain high-performance software applications using C++ or Python. Optimize and enhance existing software for efficiency, scalability, and reliability. Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including mechanical, electrical, computer vision, and software engineers. Implement best practices in software engineering, including code reviews, unit testing, and documentation. Debug, troubleshoot, and resolve software defects and performance issues. Strong proficiency in C++ (C++11/14/17/20) and Python. Experience working with robotics and/or autonomous systems. Experience with multi-threading, concurrency, and performance optimization. Familiarity with software development methodologies and design patterns. Knowledge of system programming, memory management, and debugging tools. Experience with version control systems (Git) and agile development practices. Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work in a fast-paced environment. Professional experience in software development preferred. You'll Stand Out: Experience with GPU programming (CUDA, OpenCL) or parallel computing. Knowledge of networking protocols and distributed systems. Exposure to machine learning frameworks (TensorFlow, PyTorch) or scientific computing. Experience with DevOps tools (Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines) What We Offer: Competitive salary ACS Equity Package Health, Dental, Vision Insurance Paid Time Off Allen Control Systems is an Equal Opportunity Employer, providing equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment. Research Engineer – Semiconductor Materials Job Locations US-NJ-Princeton ID 2026-6460 Category Engineering Position Type Full-Time Worker Type On-Site Overview SRI International has an immediate opening in our Princeton, NJ campus for a Research Engineer in Semiconductor Materials . This position will leverage deep knowledge of semiconductor materials growth and fabrication to aid our in-house foundry. In this position, you will work with a small, dedicated research team on existing programs, with the long term goal of cultivating your own programs and research directions. Successful candidates will have a strong background in semiconductor material growth – particularly by MOCVD in commercial machines – as well as an understanding of how to characterize these materials and integrate into fabrication processes. Ideally the candidate has developed their understanding through extensive hands-on experience in materials growth and characterization. Our work aims to leverage these materials into inventing new technologies and techniques, developing prototypes, and constructing fieldable systems. Activities will be very hands-on, operating over a variety of projects related to national security. SRI’s Advanced Technology and Systems Division conducts innovative research and development in a wide range of disciplines, from hardware security and mixed-signal integrated circuits to novel nanoscale optoelectronic devices and quantum sensing. Candidates will have the opportunity to work on programs outside of the MOCVD focus area and contribute to innovations at all levels of the development process. This position will be on-site in Princeton, NJ. Responsibilities Conduct MOCVD growth of III-V materials (InP, GaAs, GaSb), including control of composition, doping, and layer thickness (down to quantum wells). Characterize grown materials and adjust growth processes to optimize growth conditions. Maintenance of existing growth and characterization equipment and installation and qualification of new equipment. Seek, develop, and champion new research opportunities. Write and win proposals as a member of our team to actively seek funding from various government and commercial agencies. Make technical presentations to external clients, academic, government, and industry audiences and to internal staff. Qualifications Required - M.S. or Ph.D. in Materials Science or related field. 02401fd0-e513-4463-af92-6aeec9a13974.description: About Solace Healthcare in the U.S. is fundamentally broken. The system is so complex that 88% of U.S. adults do not have the health literacy necessary to navigate it without help. Solace cuts through the red tape of healthcare by pairing patients with expert advocates and giving them the tools to make better decisions—and get better outcomes. We're a Series C startup, founded in 2022 and backed by Inspired Capital, Craft Ventures, Torch Capital, Menlo Ventures, Signalfire, and IVP. Our U.S. based team is lean, mission-driven, and growing quickly. Solace isn't a place to coast. We're here to redefine healthcare—and that demands urgency, precision, and heart. If you're looking to stretch yourself, sharpen your edge, and do the best work of your life alongside a team that cares deeply, you're in the right place. We’re intense, and we like it that way. Read more in our Bloomberg funding announcement here . About Solace Healthcare in the U.S. is fundamentally broken. The system is so complex that 88% of U.S. adults do not have the health literacy necessary to navigate it without help. Solace cuts through the red tape of healthcare by pairing patients with expert advocates and giving them the tools to make better decisions, and get better outcomes. We're a Series C startup, founded in 2022 and backed by Inspired Capital, Craft Ventures, Torch Capital, Menlo Ventures, Signalfire, and IVP. Our U.S. based team is lean, mission-driven, and growing quickly. Solace isn't a place to coast. We're here to redefine healthcare, and that demands urgency, precision, and heart. If you're looking to stretch yourself, sharpen your edge, and do the best work of your life alongside a team that cares deeply, you're in the right place. We're intense, and we like it that way. Read more in our Bloomberg funding announcement here . About the Role This is a rare chance to learn data engineering from the inside out at one of the fastest-growing healthcare startups in the country. As an Associate Data Engineer at Solace, you'll help build the data platform behind how millions of people experience healthcare. You won't be relegated to toy ETL exercises or endless onboarding. You'll ship real pipeline code that moves billions of rows a month and powers the analytics, machine learning, and decisions behind our patient advocacy marketplace. You’ll have mentorship from senior and staff engineers and ownership of your work from design through deployment. You don't need years of experience, but you do need an innate ability to get things done. This role is for the ambitious, the curious, and those who don't shy away from feedback. If you're the kind of person who sees a problem and can't resist solving it, keep reading. This is an in person role in our Redwood City office, 3 days a week. What You'll Do Ship production pipeline code in your first weeks: real data flowing to real stakeholders. Build across the data platform, from ingestion to orchestration to modeling, using Python, Airflow, dbt, and Snowflake, learning the full lifecycle of modern data engineering. Take ownership of pipelines end-to-end. You'll be accountable for what you build, and you'll feel the weight and pride of that responsibility. Debug production data issues, refactor messy transformations, and improve reliability. Not glamorous, but essential, and you'll learn more from this than any course could teach you. Learn infrastructure as code with Terraform and cloud services (AWS), understanding how the platform your pipelines run on is provisioned and secured. Participate in code reviews, architecture discussions, and data modeling decisions. Your voice matters here, even on day one. Grow your craft: learn how to design pipelines, write production code, understand industry best practices and make smart engineering tradeoffs. What You Bring to the Table A bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience), graduating between December 2026 and June 2027. Solid fundamentals in programming, data structures, and databases. Working knowledge of Python and SQL, and the drive to level up fast. Projects that show you can build real things: internships, personal projects, hackathons, open source contributions. We care about what you've shipped, not just what you studied. An appreciation for the gravity of handling sensitive medical data, and a willingness to learn secure, compliant engineering practices (PHI/PII, access controls). A bias toward action. You have an exceptional craving for momentum, and you'd rather ship something solid and iterate than wait for perfect. Curiosity for how systems work, comfort with ambiguity, and a refined palate for controlled chaos. Confident communication. You can explain your thinking simply, take feedback without defensiveness, and collaborate with people who aren't engineers. A sense of care. You take pride in the details, because in healthcare data, the details are the difference. A hunger to learn and an ego small enough to admit when you don't know something. Bonus Points Exposure to Airflow, dbt, Snowflake, or another cloud data warehouse. Familiarity with Terraform, Docker, or AWS/GCP. Experience working with APIs and semi-structured data. Our Tech Stack Compute Storage: Snowflake, Postgres Orchestration: Airflow Infrastructure: Terraform, AWS Transformation: dbt, SQL, Python Up for the Challenge? We look forward to meeting you. 50e60fbf-697c-49e1-88be-1f24e17fa22d.description: Junior Product Engineer | Software Engineer I - DefenseStorm - Career Page Skip To Job Description View All Jobs View Our Website At DefenseStorm, we believe in building a community of trust so that we can grow and thrive together. Our core values guide everything we do: we build relationships intentionally, we deliver on commitments, we embrace purposeful change, and we reinforce the positive. If you are looking for a place where you can make a difference, grow your career, and be part of a supportive and dynamic team, then look no further. Join us and be part of something extraordinary! Junior Product Engineer | Software Engineer I Alpharetta, GA Full Time Engineering Entry Level Share Junior Product Engineer | Software Engineer I As a Product Engineer (SDE1), you’ll help shape and deliver features for the GRID platform through specification-driven, agentic development. You’ll understand customer and business problems, translate them into precise specifications, and guide AI agents through implementation. You’ll remain accountable for the resulting product: reviewing agent output, validating behavior, refining requirements, and ensuring the solution delivers customer value. This role is not a traditional software development position centered on manually writing code. Its core responsibilities are using judgment to define what should be built, directing agentic development, and ensuring what ships solves customer problems. Location Atlanta, GA Remote Job Duties and Responsibilities Collaborate with product, design, engineering, and customer-facing teams to shape the right outcomes. Define clear problem statements, requirements, acceptance criteria, and implementation constraints. Break initiatives into small, independently deliverable increments for agent execution. Direct AI agents through iterative development workflows. Review generated implementations for correctness, maintainability, security, and alignment with the specification. Validate results through tests, demonstrations, and customer-focused evaluation. Diagnose failures to improve context, specifications, and the agent harness. Other duties as assigned by management Required Education and Experience Bachelor's or master's degree in computer science or related field. ​​​​​​​ 0-4 years of experience building and maintaining production software systems. An AI-native mindset and genuine interest in building software through agentic workflows. Strong ability to turn ambiguous problems into precise specifications and measurable acceptance criteria. Proficiency with software engineering so you can evaluate agent-produced architecture, data flow, tests, edge cases, and security. Comfort iterating quickly, learning from failures, and improving instructions based on results. A high standard for reviewing and validating work rather than accepting generated output at face value. Clear communication, sound judgment, ownership, and a collaborative mindset. 894170e1-a1af-4afa-9a09-988a0a205b88.title: Software Engineer - Implementation
894170e1-a1af-4afa-9a09-988a0a205b88.description: We're building a new system of record for finance, one that understands not just the numbers, but the business context behind them. At its core is our Operational Ledger: a financial data layer that preserves every event, calculation, policy, source, and decision behind the financials, rather than reducing them to contextless entries. Questions that once took weeks to answer become as routine as a Google search: Why did margins change? Which customers are actually profitable? How are we tracking against budget? We're not bolting AI onto legacy software. Quanta was built from the ground up around granular financial data, flexible primitives, and systems that agents can safely understand and act on. We've spent years closing the books for real, fast-growing companies and turning what we learn into product. We've already replaced much of what QuickBooks and NetSuite can do and the manual work surrounding them. Customers are now turning off legacy accounting systems and moving to Quanta. We're still early. The problems are hard, the ambition is enormous, and there's no playbook for what we're building. The Team We're a small tight-knit team working together in person in downtown San Francisco. Our team brings together deep expertise in engineering and finance. We've built accounting systems at Affirm, ledgers at Stripe and Robinhood, launched products from 0→1, scaled infrastructure processing billions of dollars, built finance functions, and closed the books under real operating pressure. We understand our customers because we have been in their shoes. Quanta's earliest product was built around a few principles we still value: get to learning as quickly as possible, find the simplest solution that works, and build alongside real users and real-world edge cases. Quanta is for people who want ownership, prioritize learning and outcomes over conventional playbooks, and are comfortable figuring things out as they go. The principles behind our earliest product still shape how we build today: get to learning fast, choose the simplest solution that works, and build with real users in the messy reality of real-world edge cases. What We’re Looking For Hungry for ownership, we're looking for ambitious early-career engineers who want a level of ownership they wouldn't get for years at a large company. Strong technical fundamentals across modern backend and frontend systems Strong project management skills, you're going to own customer-facing projects end-to-end, and you'll need to be incredibly organized Exceptionally fast learner, you will need to quickly understand accounting concepts, including their invariants Strong communication collaboration skills, you're going to be working closely with customers and accountants every day Bonus points for experience with financial systems, ledgers, or accounting workflows. You are excited about working in person with a collaborative team in San Francisco . This Role Is Not for You If… You prefer clearly defined problems with detailed specs, rather than shaping solutions in ambiguous spaces. You are uncomfortable working in a complex, judgment-heavy domain where correctness depends on context, not just code. You optimize for speed by accepting known gaps in reliability. Trust matters deeply in the systems we build. You are primarily interested in AI as a standalone feature, rather than as part of a larger, constrained system. You prefer working independently or remotely from domain experts. This team works closely and in person by design. What Success Looks Like in 6–12 Months You have successfully owned the implementation of 3-5 customers You have deep familiarity with Quanta’s core systems and are comfortable working where correctness is most critical. You have owned and shipped improvements used daily by internal teams and customers. You have shaped at least one core abstraction that increases flexibility without compromising trust. You have helped define how the team uses AI in practice to increase leverage. You feel strong ownership over outcomes, not just code. Why Quanta Build a category, not just features. We're not selling a slightly better version of an established tool. We're changing what companies should expect from their financial systems. Join early enough to matter. We're a small team. The things you discover, build, and prove can become part of how Quanta sells for years. Learn directly from exceptional people. You'll work alongside founders, engineers, and finance leaders who have built financial infrastructure and operated finance functions firsthand. Grow with the company. We're looking for someone who wants to master outbound, take on increasing ownership, and help us build the sales organization that comes next. Benefits Competitive early-stage salary Competitive early-stage equity Health, dental, and vision insurance 401(k) Take-what-you-need paid vacation Commuter benefits Wellness stipend Paid lunches and dinners in the office All the equipment and tools you need to do your best work

1ca5e526-fbd6-44f5-bc8a-870e4dd5c496.title: Software Engineer - Internal Tools
1ca5e526-fbd6-44f5-bc8a-870e4dd5c496.description: <p>PlanetScale is growing rapidly and reinventing the database space. The PlanetScale platform offers both PostgreSQL and Vitess clusters. Vitess is an open-source database clustering system for horizontal scaling of MySQL that enables businesses to efficiently handle large-scale data workloads — without sacrificing developer experience. We re bringing the same scaling power to PostgreSQL with Neki, our sharded PostgreSQL product.</p> <p>We re hiring a software engineer to build the internal tools that run PlanetScale. You ll automate the manual work that slows a growing company down: incident response, on-call, support workflows, onboarding, and the dozens of other small things that take up our time.</p> <p><strong>Location</strong></p> <p>This role is in-office only at our San Francisco headquarters. You must already live in the SF Bay Area and be able to work from the office most days.</p> <p>This is not a remote role. We do not offer relocation. We do not sponsor visas.</p> <p>If you need to relocate, work remotely, or need visa sponsorship, please do not apply.</p> <h2>What You ll Do</h2> <ul> <li>Build AI-enabled tools and agents that automate manual work across engineering, support, and operations</li> <li>Write bots and integrations for Slack, PagerDuty, and the other systems we run the business on</li> <li>Build internal dashboards that give the team visibility into what s actually happening</li> <li>Integrate LLM APIs and AI coding tools directly into the internal systems you build</li> <li>Ship small, useful things fast. Iterate based on what people need</li> <li>Work directly with senior engineers and leadership to find friction and fix it</li> <li>Own your projects end to end: design, build, ship, support</li> </ul> <p>For example, you might:</p> <ul> <li>Automate our incident response process</li> <li>Build automations for customer support</li> <li>Build internal dashboards that measure our service quality</li> </ul> <h2>What We re Looking For</h2> <p><strong>Required:</strong></p> <ul> <li>0-2 years of professional software engineering experience, or equivalent project or internship work</li> <li>Solid fundamentals in at least one of TypeScript, Ruby, or Go</li> <li>Comfortable building with AI coding tools and LLM APIs. This role is AI-enabled work, not just AI-assisted</li> <li>Comfort writing scripts, small services, or automations that solve a real problem</li> <li>Clear written communication</li> <li>Already based in the San Francisco Bay Area. We do not relocate for this role.</li> <li>In-office at our San Francisco headquarters most days. This is not remote.</li> <li>Authorized to work in the US without sponsorship. We cannot sponsor visas.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Nice to Have:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience with Slack s API, GitHub Actions, or similar automation platforms</li> <li>Exposure to Terraform or Kubernetes</li> <li>A side project, bot, or tool you built to automate something in your own life</li> </ul> <h2>About You</h2> <p>You fix the annoying thing to save time. You d rather ship something small this week than plan something big for next quarter. You ask good questions, take feedback well, and want to learn from engineers more senior than you. You want to be in the room with your team, not on a call. You re excited about AI tools not just to write code faster, but to design and ship whole systems.</p> <h2>Why PlanetScale</h2> <p>We re redefining how high-growth companies manage data at scale—and we work with some of the most exciting brands in gaming, consumer tech, and B2B SaaS. As a Software Engineer, you ll be at the core of building the platform that powers world-class apps used by hundreds of millions of users worldwide. PlanetScale is a profitable company with a philosophy centered around building small teams of p99 individuals and is recognized as one of the fastest growing companies in America.</p> <p>At PlanetScale we believe in supporting people to do their best work. Our mission is to build a diverse, equitable, and inclusive company. We strive to build an inclusive environment where all people feel that they are equally respected and valued, whether they are a candidate or an employee. We welcome applicants of any educational background, gender identity and expression, sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, age, citizenship, socioeconomic status, disability, pregnancy status, and veteran status.</p> <p>If you have a disability, please let us know if there s any way we can make the interview process better for you; we re happy to accommodate!</p> <h3>Total Compensation and Pay Transparency</h3> <p>An employee s total compensation consists of base salary + variable comp where appropriate + benefits + equity. A member of our Talent Acquisition team will be happy to answer any further questions when we engage with you to begin the interview process.</p> <p>Base salary range: $120,000 - $160,000 USD</p> <p> nbsp;</p>

8adee4fc-765b-4e1a-8de9-ec518bf68f19.title: Software Engineer 1
8adee4fc-765b-4e1a-8de9-ec518bf68f19.description: <p><strong>The Role</strong></p> <p>Everlaw is looking for a Software Engineer to join our team. This is an amazing opportunity to launch your engineering career, make a real impact on our product and grow your skills with a team that s committed to your success.You’ll own complex product features from idea to full release, operating with significant autonomy across our entire tech stack to shape how legal teams uncover truth in vast amounts of data. Rather than being a cog in a massive pipeline or working under strict sprint cycles, you’ll build systems end-to-end alongside a dedicated product lead and designer, focusing on deep code quality and long-term maintainability.</p> <p><strong>This is a full-time, exempt position based in our Oakland, CA office with a hybrid work schedule: in office M/W/Th with the option to work from home on Tu/Fr.</strong></p> <p><strong>What you ll do</strong></p> <ul> <li>Build new product features end-to-end, taking projects from initial architectural design through implementation and deployment.</li> <li>Collaborate closely with Product, Design, and Developer Operations to design, build, and launch functionality seamlessly.</li> <li>Maintain and improve the reliability of our platform by debugging complex issues across a large-scale codebase.</li> <li>Contribute to system documentation and team knowledge-sharing to keep our codebase easy to navigate and maintain.</li> <li>Partner with your dedicated onboarding mentor to ramp up quickly on our platform architecture, development practices, and product domains.</li> </ul> <p><strong>About You</strong></p> <ul> <li>You have a BS or MS in Computer Science, or equivalent coursework.</li> <li>You have experience and proficiency in coding in a compiled language (C++, Java, etc) and scripting language (Python, JavaScript, etc).</li> <li>You have a strong foundational knowledge of computer science concepts, algorithms, and data structures.</li> <li>You ve built and delivered software projects through class assignments, personal projects, or internships.</li> <li>You bring strong strategic thinking and a collaborative approach to solving complex technical problems.</li> <li>You are authorized to work in the United States. Please note that at this time, Everlaw is not sponsoring U.S. employment visas for this role.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Bonus points</strong></p> <ul> <li>You are familiar with Linux operating systems and environments.</li> <li>You have hands-on experience using Git or a similar version control system.</li> <li>You have strong written and verbal communication skills.</li> <li>You have held a campus leadership position or completed a technical research program.</li> </ul> <p>Think you re missing some of the skills and are hesitant to apply? We do not believe in the perfect candidate and encourage you to apply if you feel you can bring value to our team. We often revisit candidates who may have applied for a different role if something comes up that s a better fit.</p> <p><strong>The Team: Engineering</strong></p> <p>The Engineering team solves problems that are genuinely rare in their scope and scale. Few companies operate on the volume and variety of data Everlaw does, and even fewer must make that data instantly searchable, explainable, secure, and trustworthy enough to stake a legal case on. By balancing technical power with a remarkably intuitive experience, Engineering builds systems that help legal teams find the truth in mountains of evidence faster and with greater confidence.</p> <p><strong>Total Rewards amp; Benefits</strong></p> <p>The base salary for this role is $140,000 per year. This role is also eligible for equity and the benefits below.</p> <p><strong>Health amp; well-being</strong></p> <ul> <li>Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage</li> <li>Flexible Spending Accounts for health and dependent care expenses</li> <li>Membership to Modern Health to support mental health and wellness</li> <li>Paid parental leave</li> <li>Company-sponsored life and disability insurance</li> </ul> <p><strong>Financial rewards</strong></p> <ul> <li>Competitive equity grants, so you share in Everlaw s long-term growth</li> <li>401(k) plan with company matching of up to 4% of eligible annual compensation</li> </ul> <p><strong>Growth amp; everyday perks</strong></p> <ul> <li>17 paid vacation days, 11 federal holidays, and paid sick leave</li> <li>Four Everlawlidays (additional paid company-wide days off) per year</li> <li>Annual allocation for learning amp; development and relevant professional membership dues</li> <li>Hybrid work with regular work-from-home days and flexibility for life s logistics</li> <li>Monthly home internet reimbursement, plus a stipend for your desk setup</li> <li>Catered lunch each workday, plus snacks and company-wide events in our offices</li> </ul> <p><strong>About Everlaw</strong></p> <p>When a lawsuit or investigation happens, teams must comb through vast amounts of electronic evidence — emails, documents, chats, files — to find what matters. That work is not a side task but the case itself, and where most of the time and money in litigation goes. Everlaw is the litigation and investigation management platform changing that, using AI to turn mountains of me

6fde7390-e210-402b-86f4-5aefd801f16d.title: Software Engineer - Product
6fde7390-e210-402b-86f4-5aefd801f16d.description: Build the platform that will power every type of financial institution onboarding Prelim is seeking a Software Engineer, Product to join our rapidly growing and fully remote US team. You'll have the opportunity to architect and build the platform that handles every conceivable type of financial institution onboarding, from simple deposit accounts to complex treasury services for millions of people. If you're passionate about solving massive-scale engineering challenges and eager to be part of a fast-paced remote startup culture, we encourage you to apply to join our team today! As a Software Engineer, Product at Prelim, you will own critical parts of the platform that powers digital onboarding for financial institutions across the world. You'll work directly with our customers, product team, and engineering leadership to build systems that handle everything from online deposit account opening to in-branch experiences, account maintenance, treasury services onboarding, credit card applications, and every other type of financial institution onboarding imaginable. This isn't just another full-stack role, it's the chance to build the infrastructure that millions depend on. Key Responsibilities: Architect and build features across our entire stack handling massive scale and complexity. Build, enhance and fix the systems that seamlessly integrate with legacy bank infrastructure, core banking systems, and third-party compliance providers. Solve complex technical challenges around multi-tenant architecture, real-time data processing, and bank-grade reliability requirements. Work directly with major banks to understand their unique onboarding requirements and translate complex business logic into elegant technical solutions. Own the performance, scalability, and reliability of systems processing millions of applications across hundreds of different banking products. Qualifications: Experience with modern web technologies (React, Node.js, PostgreSQL preferred). Whether you're a new graduate with impressive projects or an experienced engineer, we want to hear from you. Strong system design skills and experience with scalable architectures, you'll be building systems that immediately help millions. You thrive on solving complex technical problems with business context. You can break down complicated banking requirements and build elegant solutions. You care about business impact and can balance technical excellence with shipping features that move the business forward. You think deeply about user experience, whether you're building for every day people opening accounts or bank employees processing applications. You're excited about working directly with customers, understanding their complex needs, and iterating quickly based on feedback. You want to own significant parts of the product and help shape technical decisions as we scale. A Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or Software Engineering. Legally authorized to work in the United States and located within the continental United States About Prelim Prelim is a San Francisco and New York City-based startup that operates with fully remote positions across the US, helping banks onboard their customers. Our platform is designed to streamline the account opening process for both consumers and businesses, accelerating speed-to-market and enhancing the customer experience for financial institutions. If you’re excited to help shape the future of the banking industry, we encourage you to apply and join our team at Prelim. We are seeking individuals who are driven, ambitious, and eager to make a real impact in a traditional industry ready for technological innovation. We offer equity, a sponsored 401K, parental leave, and fully paid health, vision, and dental insurance. Additional benefits include unlimited PTO, a remote work stipend, a life-style stipend, and twice-yearly company retreats. Prelim values diversity and inclusion; people of all backgrounds are welcome to join our mission to transform banking.

These values are the foundation of our work, and we are committed to upholding them in everything we do. Our co-founders are Bret Taylor and Clay Bavor . You'll surface unmet needs, prototype new tools and features, and collaborate with research, product, and platform to shape the future of AI agent development and Sierra's product. We build trust with each other by showing up for each other professionally and personally, creating an environment that enables all of us to do our best work. Customer Obsession: We deeply understand our customers’ business goals and relentlessly focus on driving outcomes, not just technical milestones. Everyone at the company knows and spends time with our customers. When our customer is having an issue, we drop everything and fix it. Craftsmanship: We get the details right, from the words on the page to the system architecture. We have good taste. When we notice something isn’t right, we take the time to fix it. We are proud of the products we produce. We continuously self-reflect to continuously self-improve. Intensity: We know we don’t have the luxury of patience. We play to win. We care about our product being the best, and when it isn’t, we fix it. When we fail, we talk about it openly and without blame so we succeed the next time. Family: We know that balance and intensity are compatible, and we model it in our actions and processes. We are the best technology company for parents. We support and respect each other and celebrate each other’s personal and professional achievements. Here at Siemens, we take pride in enabling sustainable progress through technology. We do this through empowering customers by combining the real and digital worlds. Improving how we live, work, and move today and for the next generation! From Day 1, you are empowered to create an impact with your full potential and creativity to make a difference for tomorrow. We truly have an inclusive and diverse team culture where you can be yourself. Our extensive global presence offers a diverse range of career opportunities across various industries, nations, and job domains, empowering our workforce to continuously enhance their skills and stay competitive. Create a better tomorrow with us! Siemens is seeking an energetic and motivated Junior Software Development Engineer to join our Digital Solutions Software team. This entry-level position will contribute to the design, development, testing, deployment, and support of software solutions that combine power system data, industrial connectivity, cloud technologies, and Artificial Intelligence (AI) capabilities. Working closely with senior software engineers, architects, product managers, and power system experts, you will help develop modern applications and services that deliver intelligent insights, automation, predictive analytics, and operational value for customers across commercial, industrial, and utility environments. Develop software interfaces connecting field devices, power systems, cloud platforms, and business applications. Support the implementation of REST APIs, microservices, and cloud-connected architectures. Participate in software design reviews, code reviews, testing activities, and continuous integration/deployment processes. Collaborate with software engineers, product managers, UX designers, and domain experts to deliver product features. Assist in troubleshooting, debugging, and resolving software issues. Contribute to development schedules and project deliverables. Participate in continuous improvement initiatives for software quality, architecture, security, and development standards. Document technical designs, implementation details, and operational procedures. Support proof-of-concept and innovation projects involving AI, Industrial IoT, digital twins, and advanced analytics. Experience developing software using one or more programming languages: C#; Python; Java; C++ Familiarity with source control systems such as Git. Understanding of web technologies and API-based architectures. Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills. Software Development: C# or similar object-oriented programming language Python REST APIs and HTTP-based services Git source control Software debugging and troubleshooting Unit testing and automated testing practices Development Tools: Visual Studio and/or VS Code GitHub or Azure DevOps Docker or container technologies Must be eligible to work in the US with no sponsorship now or in the future. Preferred Qualifications: Ability to manage multiple assignments and priorities. Strong verbal and written communication skills. Demonstrated desire to learn emerging technologies and continuously develop technical expertise. Exposure to Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Generative AI, or data analytics through coursework, internships, hackathons, or personal projects. Experience with cloud platforms such as Microsoft Azure. Familiarity with modern web application frameworks. Experience developing or consuming APIs. Experience with MQTT, OPC UA, or Industrial IoT technologies. Understanding of software architecture patterns and microservices. Experience using AI-assisted development tools and coding copilots.
