8b0c8a04-8a4d-4675-8ea4-401a27ae962f.title: Software Engineer New Grad
8b0c8a04-8a4d-4675-8ea4-401a27ae962f.description: Stripe Careers | Software Engineer, New Grad Opportunity Compatibility Emerging talent Open roles Open roles Roles at Stripe / Role details Software Engineer, New Grad Who we are About Stripe Stripe is a technology company focused on improving the conditions for economic growth and prosperity. We build programmable financial infrastructure, rethinking from first principles how financial services should work, to make it easier and cheaper for any business to start and scale. More than 10 million businesses build on Stripe, spanning the economic frontier—from solo founders to established enterprises—united by a practical focus on growth. The most ambitious companies in the world use Stripe as core infrastructure to grow faster. They process trillions of dollars a year on Stripe, equivalent to around 1.6% of global GDP. While economic growth makes everyone better off, open markets also enable greater variety. When any business can easily serve a global customer base, the quality and diversity of products in the world increase, and craft and creativity are unleashed into the smallest niches. Our own growth is wholly contingent on the success of the businesses building on Stripe. We therefore invest back into our technology at an unusual rate. We make upgrades to our products every single day to deliver compounding gains to our customers. We maintain some of the most reliable APIs on the internet. We build entirely new pieces of financial infrastructure to enable new ideas. And our significant advances in risk and fraud infrastructure over many years are making the internet economy safer and more accessible. Though people at Stripe don’t tend to take themselves seriously, Stripe is a fairly serious place: our customers are depending on us for their livelihoods. We admire ambition, intensity, curiosity, humility, and rigor. The most effective people become knowledgeable about many domains besides their own. Any company is an applied exercise in understanding some aspect of society or the market. In working with so many (especially the new and innovative ones), we think that Stripe is one of the very best places to learn about how the world works. Your role Stripe is large enough that individual products and projects can be rapidly deployed to a meaningful fraction of the world’s businesses, but small enough that individual agency still has outsized impact. Small teams can impact how millions of businesses grow. Right now the global economy is replatforming around AI, creating new opportunities for growth. We’re at the center of this, and we think the best work is still in front of us. To meet this moment, we’re looking for people who move with urgency, like hard problems, and want their work to matter at a time of great change. If that’s you, there’s no better place to build your career. Who you are Ambitious builder: You’re energized by building solutions without clear precedent and solving problems with far-reaching consequences. Successful Stripes are deeply curious, and prefer the joy of discovery to the comfort of certainty. Rigorous thinker: You appreciate that things worth doing are rarely simple. You enjoy working on problems that have never been tackled before. Adaptable problem solver: You adapt quickly and treat obstacles as opportunities. At Stripe we embrace kindness while encouraging Stripes to take measured risks and act boldly, even in the absence of consensus. Minimum requirements A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in computer science or a directly related field, obtained by summer 2027, or equivalent work experience; New grad candidates should have no more than 18 months of professional experience (excluding internship experience). Experience and familiarity with programming, either through side projects or classwork. We work mostly in Java, Ruby, JavaScript, Scala, and Go. We believe new programming languages can be learned if the fundamentals and general knowledge are present. Experience from either previous internships or working collaboratively on multi-person coding projects (in a university or professional setting). Ability to learn unfamiliar systems and form an understanding of those systems, through independent research and working with a mentor or subject matter experts. Clear written communication skills, with the ability to explain your work to stakeholders, team members, and other Stripes. Ability to leverage AI tools to accelerate development while applying rigorous critical thinking and professional judgement to review, refine, and validate all outputs. Preferred qualifications One or more areas of specialized knowledge (frontend, backend, infrastructure or other technologies) balanced with general skills and knowledge. The most ambitious companies in the world use Stripe as core infrastructure to grow faster. They process trillions of dollars a year on Stripe, equivalent to around 1.6% of global GDP. While economic growth makes everyone better off, open markets also enable greater variety. When any business can easily serve a global customer base, the quality and diversity of products in the world increase, and craft and creativity are unleashed into the smallest niches. Our own growth is wholly contingent on the success of the businesses building on Stripe. We therefore invest back into our technology at an unusual rate. We make upgrades to our products every single day to deliver compounding gains to our customers. We maintain some of the most reliable APIs on the internet. We build entirely new pieces of financial infrastructure to enable new ideas. And our significant advances in risk and fraud infrastructure over many years are making the internet economy safer and more accessible. Though people at Stripe don’t tend to take themselves seriously, Stripe is a fairly serious place: our customers are depending on us for their livelihoods. We admire ambition, intensity, curiosity, humility, and rigor. The most effective people become knowledgeable about many domains besides their own. Any company is an applied exercise in understanding some aspect of society or the market. In working with so many (especially the new and innovative ones), we think that Stripe is one of the very best places to learn about how the world works. Your role Stripe is large enough that individual products and projects can be rapidly deployed to a meaningful fraction of the world’s businesses, but small enough that individual agency still has outsized impact. Small teams can impact how millions of businesses grow. Right now the global economy is replatforming around AI, creating new opportunities for growth. We’re at the center of this, and we think the best work is still in front of us. To meet this moment, we’re looking for people who move with urgency, like hard problems, and want their work to matter at a time of great change. If that’s you, there’s no better place to build your career. Who you are Ambitious builder: You’re energized by building solutions without clear precedent and solving problems with far-reaching consequences. Successful Stripes are deeply curious, and prefer the joy of discovery to the comfort of certainty. Rigorous thinker: You appreciate that things worth doing are rarely simple. You enjoy working on problems that have never been tackled before. Adaptable problem solver: You adapt quickly and treat obstacles as opportunities. At Stripe we embrace kindness while encouraging Stripes to take measured risks and act boldly, even in the absence of consensus. We believe new programming languages can be learned if the fundamentals and general knowledge are present. Experience from either previous internships or working collaboratively on multi-person coding projects (in a university or professional setting). Ability to learn unfamiliar systems and form an understanding of those systems, through independent research and working with a mentor or subject matter experts. Clear written communication skills, with the ability to explain your work to stakeholders, team members, and other Stripes. Ability to leverage AI tools to accelerate development while applying rigorous critical thinking and professional judgement to review, refine, and validate all outputs. Preferred qualifications One or more areas of specialized knowledge (frontend, backend, infrastructure or other technologies) balanced with general skills and knowledge. Experience in code review practices, and an understanding of how to safely update production systems. Familiarity with navigating and managing work in large code bases. Experience leading small projects independently, and contributing to larger projects alongside peers. Ability to operate with high agency in navigating complex technical obstacles independently, knowing precisely when to unblock oneself and when to ask for help. This is UK-market pay — a US-based Stripe new grad req would be closer to $180-210k, so the shortfall is geographic rather than company tier.

About the role Finding better ways™ to provide the materials the world needs. We're looking for graduates from a range of degrees for different areas across our business. This requisition is for a role of Graduate Geologist / Geoscientist based Rio Tinto Kennecott in Salt Lake City, Utah. We are an open, connected international team of technical specialists using some of the most exciting data and tools on the planet. We are the world leader in automation and smart mining. We have technical development programs that are industry-leading and recognize the unique nature of your role. These provide opportunities to grow your career through a dedicated technical path while being rewarded for your unique skills. Working in a collaborative community, you will be: Development, exposure, and active participation in all geologic aspects of the underground operation at the Bingham Canyon Mine. You will gain exposure to and assist in geologic mapping, ore control, geologic modelling, core logging, and LIDAR scanning with the opportunity to gain knowledge in mine planning, geotechnical engineering, hydrology, and operations. Every year, Airbus seeks bright minds from around the globe to fill critical roles that will shape our future. When you begin your career with us, we don't just offer a job; we accelerate your growth through the Airbus Global Graduate development journey. This isn't a one-size-fits-all program; it's a personalized, two-year experience designed to cultivate your professional skills, enhance your business acumen, and hone your technical abilities . We place a strong emphasis on developing your leadership potential from day one. You'll gain a unique perspective on the world of Airbus while contributing directly in a specific, impactful position. During the two years, we will take you on a soft-skill development journey , covering such areas as inclusive leadership, our Values, resilience, communication and emotional intelligence, with various in-person and virtual workshops. Beyond your daily responsibilities and this comprehensive schedule of training , you'll join your global graduate community annually for an in-person dedicated development week. This is your chance to connect with your peers, learn directly from our seasoned leaders, and gain insights from the best in the industry. Throughout the programme, you will be developed into an established and valuable team member from day 1. You'll sharpen your skills in an area strategically important to Airbus, gaining a deep understanding of our business – its opportunities, challenges, and needs. Most importantly, you'll have learned more about yourself and what makes you truly great . You will have demonstrated your capability and readiness to take on future leadership challenges within Airbus. Above all, you'll have the unparalleled opportunity to do your best work in an industry that is literally reshaping how we live in our world. If you're ready to embark on this transformative journey and unlock your full potential, apply below. What you will be doing You will be on a development journey to guide your growth into the role of AGGP2027 – Graduate Software Engineer and can expect to be involved in the following: 1. Contribute to cutting-edge projects in the aerospace and defence sector developing and implementing innovative software solutions across various domains, working within a dynamic and collaborative team environment. 2. Participate in the full software development life cycle, from requirements gathering to delivery maintenance, following both Waterfall and Agile Software development approaches. 3. Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including systems engineers, Test engineers and project managers. 4. Developing mainly in Java, you will use the latest technologies and tools to develop, test, debug, and optimise the performance of your software and that of the product. 5. Learn to write and maintain technical documentation and contribute to the continuous improvement of software development processes and tools. 6. Learn, with support, and apply new technologies and programming languages as required by project needs. 7. Supprt the integration of software components with hardware and other systems and learn to understand and adhere to industry standards, best practices, and company policies for software development and security. Your development journey will include a minimum of one rotational placement to support your growth into position. At the end of the two year development programme you will have developed into the position of AGGP2027 - Graduate Software Engineer. What we are looking for To be a successful applicant, you will need to demonstrate you have: A degree level or equivalent within Software Engineering Recently graduated or first professional experience in the field of Software Engineering Strong verbal and written communication in our business language (English) A desire to work in a collaborative team environment, focused on driving future innovation The ability to be self aware and a wish to be in the driving seat of your development. We love your interest in working for Airbus but we do ask that you make only one application to the Airbus Global Graduate Programme. Take the time to decide which of our exciting opportunities is right for you and then submit an application that best represents you, your skills and experience in connection with the role you have selected. Please note, we are unable to provide Skilled Worker visa sponsorship for this position. We welcome applications from candidates with existing right to work in the UK or those eligible via other routes (e.g., Graduate Visa, Youth Mobility Scheme). For full eligibility details, please consult UK Visas and Immigration . NB: Applications will close on 30th September 2026 (don’t delay, apply early as some roles may close before this date due to applications received). All applications and CVs need to be in English. Engineering Technician I/II ID 2026-9873 Type SCA Location : Location US-CA-San Diego Security Clearance Clearable Overview/ Job Responsibilities Entarian is looking for an Engineering Technician. This is an e ntry-level position responsible for assisting senior technicians (Tech III-VI) with installation, maintenance, and troubleshooting of ESS Systems (electronic security systems) To include, but not limited to, Closed Circuit Television (CCTV), Access Control (ACS), Intrusion Detection (IDS), and Public Annunciator (PA). This role requires a basic understanding of CCTV, access control, and intrusion detection systems. Engineering Technician I/II follows instructions provided by experienced technicians and actively learns from them through both ‘On-the-job-training’ and formal training provided through onboarding and various System Certifications applicable to a project. Roles Responsibilities : The Engineering Technician I role is an entry-level position within the Electronic Security Systems team, offering individuals an opportunity to gain foundational experience in the field. This role plays a crucial part in assisting senior technicians with various tasks related to the installation, maintenance, and troubleshooting of electronic security systems. Assist Senior Technicians: Collaborate with senior technicians to support the installation of electronic security systems, including CCTV cameras, access control panels, and intrusion detection sensors. Assist in the setup and configuration of security equipment according to project specifications. Perform Maintenance Tasks: Aid in conducting routine maintenance activities on installed security systems to ensure optimal performance and functionality. Assist in diagnosing and troubleshooting basic system issues, under the guidance of senior technicians. Learn and Follow Instructions: Follow instructions provided by experienced technicians meticulously to ensure tasks are executed accurately and efficiently. Actively observe and learn from senior technicians, seeking clarification when needed to enhance understanding. Develop Basic Understanding: Develop a basic understanding of electronic security systems, including CCTV, access control, and intrusion detection systems. Familiarize oneself with the components, wiring diagrams, and technical documentation associated with these systems. Quality Assurance: Pay close attention to detail to ensure that tasks are performed accurately and in accordance with established standards and procedures. Contribute to maintaining high-quality workmanship by adhering to best practices and quality control measures. Team Collaboration: Work collaboratively with team members to accomplish project objectives and deliverables. Communicate effectively with colleagues to provide updates on task progress and seek assistance or guidance when needed. Professional Development: Demonstrate eagerness to learn and grow within the field of electronic security systems. Take advantage of opportunities for training and skill development provided by the organization to enhance knowledge and expertise. $24/hr to $32/hr DOE Minimum Qualifications Ability to obtain a DoD Secret Clearance. Must be a U.S. Citizen. Valid Driver’s License Travel up to 50% to CONUS and OCONUS locations may be required. High school diploma or equivalent. Basic knowledge of electronics or related fields. Strong problem-solving skills. Ability to work effectively in a team environment. Attention to detail to ensure accurate task execution. Eagerness to learn and commitment to maintaining quality workmanship. Basic understanding and experience with Basic Hand tools. (*S1T Does NOT Provide Basic Hand tools) Desired Qualifications Tower Climbing experience/certification. Forklift/ Boom operator experience/certification. Fiber Optic Certification(s) Experienced with Navy Shore Platform Installation Handbook Knowledge of Government Off-the-Shelf (GOTS) physical security system Access Control Enforcer (ACE) and its integration with ACS Understanding of DMP systems Manufacturer certifications if required (Avigilon, Axis, DMP, Lenel, AMAG, Honeywell, Galaxy, FLIR, and Pelco.) Install, program and document ACS/IDS/CCTV equipment, cable conveyance, antennas and supporting systems. Communication/ Low Voltage Equipment rack and supporting system peripheral installations. Installation of overhead or under-floor infrastructure (Conduit, EMT, Schedule 40) and low voltage cabling. Proficiency in using basic tools and various low voltage testing equipment. Active Secret Clearance Ability to obtain a passport About Us Formed through the strategic union of Sev1Tech and ERT, Entarian is a premier provider of mission-critical engineering and technology solutions. Founded on a legacy of excellence dating back to 1993, Entarian is a product of an evolved and fully diversified engineering and federal technology leader. From deep space to defense and civilian missions, Entarian delivers secure, mission-aligned digital solutions that drive national resilience and operational effectiveness. 3fc4727f-2d70-46d1-bcff-ca511ef255d0.description: <div class= content-intro ><p><a href= https://www.dataiku.com/?utm_source=newswire amp;utm_medium=press-release amp;utm_campaign=PlatformforAISuccess target= _blank >Dataiku</a> is the Platform for AI Success, the enterprise orchestration layer for building, deploying, and governing AI. exposure to Domain Driven Design desirable.</li> <li>Some experience with asynchronous messaging technologies such as Google PubSub, Kafka.</li> <li>In depth knowledge of NoSQL and RDBMS technologies.</li> <li>Strong experience with Docker, Kubernetes, Cloud Environments (GCP preferred).</li> <li>Experience working on agile teams.</li> <li>Excellent communication and collaboration skills in all mediums.</li> <li>Experience working on and scaling a microservice-based application.</li> <li>A proven ability to thrive in a collaborative environment involving different stakeholders and subject matter experts.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Ready to join us?</strong></p> <p>Synack is committed to embracing diversity. Are you passionate about developing solutions to complex engineering challenges? We are seeking motivated developers, computer scientists, computer engineers, and cyber researchers who are passionate about advancing the field of cybersecurity. Specifically, we are searching for candidates with interest and experience in software, hardware, and/or firmware reverse engineering. We work hard to build a team with a variety of perspectives and experiences to tackle cross-discipline problem sets. The Systems Exploitation team performs vulnerability research, develops novel cyber capabilities, and pioneers groundbreaking approaches to defeat sophisticated security protections. As a member of our team, you will perform deep investigation of software, hardware, and firmware. You will build forward-thinking solutions for prototype and operational systems. You will gain experience and articulate your ideas in papers and presentations to technical staff, management, and government decision makers. We strongly encourage our team to take advantage of opportunities to participate in working groups, customer meetings, proposal writing, and conferences. As a multidisciplinary research center, APL also encourages collaboration across disciplines, giving you the opportunity to work alongside world-class experts in fields such as artificial intelligence, biotechnology, space exploration, radio communications, and additive manufacturing. We'd love to have you join our team! Qualifications You meet our minimum qualifications for the job if you... Have a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Cybersecurity, Electrical Engineering, or similar. Are skilled in and/or have knowledge of vulnerability analysis and reverse engineering of software, hardware, and/or firmware. Are able to acquire a Secret level security clearance by your start date and can ultimately obtain TS/SCI level clearance or higher. If selected, you will be subject to a government security clearance investigation and must meet the requirements for access to classified information. Eligibility requirements include U.S. citizenship. You will go above and beyond our minimum requirements if you... Understand the internals of major operating systems, exploitation techniques, and exploit mitigations. Have experience reading or writing assembly (x86/x64, Arm, PowerPC, MIPS, or others). Understand wire-level protocols and radio frequency communications. Have used debuggers such as gdb, WinDbg, or OllyDbg, and you have worked with reverse engineering tools such as IDA Pro, Binary Ninja, or Ghidra. Enjoy crafting and prototyping hardware, including PCB design and leveraging on-chip instrumentation standards such as JTAG. Hold a TS/SCI clearance with full-scope polygraph. Have prior experience working with government agencies or in a government agency setting. About Us Why Work at APL? The Johns Hopkins University Applied Physics Laboratory (APL) brings world-class expertise to our nation’s most critical defense, security, space and science challenges. While we are dedicated to solving complex challenges and pioneering new technologies, what makes us truly outstanding is our culture. We offer a vibrant, welcoming atmosphere where you can bring your authentic self to work, continue to grow, and build strong connections with inspiring teammates. At APL, we celebrate our differences of perspectives and encourage creativity and bold, new ideas. Our employees enjoy generous benefits, including a robust education assistance program, unparalleled retirement contributions, and a healthy work/life balance. APL’s campus is located in the Baltimore-Washington metro area. Learn more about our career opportunities at https://www.jhuapl.edu/careers . Actual compensation may vary based on factors such as geographic location, work experience, market conditions, education/training and skill level with consideration for internal parity. Familiarity with observability platforms such as Datadog, AppDynamics, Grafana, Prometheus, or ELK. Interest in AI, automation, and distributed systems.

2595dd8b-05e9-45e8-bc02-8d6e4ab72521.description: Technology keeps the world moving - It’s no different here at Hot Topic. We are looking for a motivated, hands-on Junior Analyst to help support and maintain our Warehouse Management System (WMS) and related warehouse applications. In this role, you will assist with system testing, troubleshooting, enhancements, and day-to-day maintenance to ensure warehouse operations run smoothly and efficiently. You will work closely with senior analysts, warehouse operations teams, and IT partners to help coordinate system updates, support new functionality, and validate changes through structured testing. The ideal candidate is eager to learn, communicates clearly, collaborates well with others, and builds strong working relationships across teams to help deliver effective solutions that support warehouse and distribution operations. This role can be based in the Nashville, TN or Riverside, CA offices. Minimum 3 days a week onsite up to 5 days per week. WHAT YOU'LL DO: Troubleshoot and diagnose WMS-related issues to determine whether they stem from system configuration, data integrity, integrations, or warehouse process gaps. Provide hands-on technical support or escalate complex issues to the appropriate internal or vendor teams. Partner with warehouse operations, supply chain teams, project managers, and third-party vendors to define project scope, align on system enhancements, establish WMS goals, and proactively identify and resolve system or process issues. Assist in extracting WMS data and conducting detailed analysis of warehouse process flows, ensuring system functionality aligns with existing operational workflows such as receiving, putaway, picking, packing, replenishment, and shipping. Support senior analysts with WMS configuration, implementation, testing, documentation, and ongoing system support to ensure business functions operate efficiently within the warehouse environment. Communicate WMS system enhancements, updates, and modifications to key stakeholders, helping bridge the gap between technical solutions and operational impact. Assist in developing and executing WMS test cases in partnership with the QA team to validate system changes, enhancements, integrations, and new functionality as part of the Quality Assurance process. Support end-user training for warehouse associates and operational leaders on WMS functionality, new tools, system updates, and best practices to drive adoption and minimize disruptions. WHAT YOU'LL NEED: 0-1 years of experience and exposure in Systems Development Life Cycle and/or experience in supporting systems as a System/IT Analyst or developer. Internships welcomed. Knowledge about Supply Chain, Warehouses, and/or retail. Experience in the preparation of process charts and analysis that reflect workflow, external validation and audit points, and output requirements. Shown the ability to be able to translate technical terms to business terms. Exposure to working with IT Systems with basic knowledge of SDLC life cycle and exposure to Databases/API's and Messaging ( XML/JSON). Nice to have: Cognos SCI, Manhattan WMS experience.

3b2dc0d1-97dd-4f1f-8a0b-2343f43fb5c8.title: Lead Generative AI Engineer
3b2dc0d1-97dd-4f1f-8a0b-2343f43fb5c8.description: About Motorway Motorway is the UK's largest online car-selling platform. We connect private sellers directly with over 8,000 dealers nationwide. Our online platform helps sellers achieve great prices for their cars while giving dealers fast, reliable access to the stock they want for their dealerships. Founded in 2017, our award-winning, technology-led approach has redefined the experience of selling a car. Motorway is backed by some of the world’s leading technology investors, having raised £143 million in Series C funding. This is a unique opportunity to join a fast-growing scale-up at a crucial phase of growth and help change an industry for the better. About the team GenAI Engineering sits within Motorway's Data and AI function, alongside Machine Learning and the Machine Learning Data Platform. We own the AI features that shape how buyers and sellers experience the marketplace, from agentic workflows in the customer journey to LLM-powered tooling for our dealer network. What we build goes into the hands of real sellers and thousands of verified dealers, usually within weeks. When it works, someone sells their car more easily. When it doesn't, we hear about it. That feedback loop is short, and it shapes how we work. We have a track record of successful deployments and a strong reputation as a result. Over the next two years the function scales from shipping AI features to running a serious GenAI platform. About the role We're looking for a Lead GenAI Engineer to set the technical standard for AI work across the function, and to build the hardest parts of it themselves. You'll own the architecture and standards for complex, product-facing GenAI work. You'll hold sign-off on the systems that carry real risk, and you'll be the person a squad comes to when they've hit something genuinely hard. This is a player-coach role: your own code sets the bar others refer back to, and you'll spend as much energy making senior engineers better as you do building. Most of what makes a GenAI feature good sits around the model rather than in it. The prompting is rarely the hard part. Retrieval quality is, and so is the data feeding it, evaluation you can trust, sensible behaviour when things fail, and getting it live and keeping it there. The standards that matter most here are the ones that make that work repeatable across teams. We're not precious about the route you took to this kind of engineering. You'll report to the Engineering Manager for GenAI Engineering, partnering closely with the Principal GenAI Engineer, the Director of Data and AI, and product leadership. In this role, you will: Set the architecture standard for complex GenAI work across the function, not by mandate but by building things others learn from and want to adopt. Hold sign-off on materially complex AI systems, catching architectural, safety and reliability problems before they reach production. Own the shared foundations that determine feature quality across teams: retrieval patterns, evaluation infrastructure, data pipelines, and the tooling that makes good practice the easy path. Build the hardest pieces of work directly, acting as the technical escalation point for the function's toughest problems. Design for systems that stay up and stay affordable, covering graceful degradation, fallback behaviour, and cost and latency at production scale. Develop the senior engineers around you by handing them harder problems, room to own decisions, and honest feedback. Shape how we hire and review, bringing a clear and defensible view of what good looks like. Bring specific, actionable industry insight into planning, explaining what a development means for our architecture rather than noting that the field moves fast. About you You've set technical direction that other engineering teams actually adopted, and you can talk about where that worked and where it didn't. Strong Python, and SQL you genuinely use. A lot of this work is data work: grounding data, golden datasets, and understanding why something failed. Deep, current expertise across the GenAI stack, including retrieval at scale, vector stores, agentic orchestration, multimodal work, evaluation infrastructure and fine-tuning where it earns its place. You're fluent in the layer underneath: MLOps tooling, deployment and cloud infrastructure (we run on AWS and GCP), and you can tell the difference between a choice that matters and one that doesn't. You design systems that survive contact with production, and you've been on the hook when they didn't. A strong point of view on evaluation, including the difference between evals that catch regressions and evals that provide comfort. Your direct contributions set a quality bar for the people around you. You explain hard technical trade-offs to non-technical stakeholders without either condescending or losing the substance. Self-awareness about where your knowledge runs out, and the instinct to bring in expertise early. You could be a great fit if You build with taste, preferring simple systems that work over clever ones that nearly do. You use authority sparingly. You're not a blocker, but you'll stop a bad decision from shipping. You get satisfaction from the unglamorous work that makes AI features actually good, not just the part that demos well. You enjoy making other engineers better as much as building things yourself. You've levelled people up in a way they'd recognise, whether through a talk, a review, or how you work day to day. You hold a two-to-three-year view without losing touch with what's shipping this month. BENEFITS We've got your back, in life's biggest moments and the everyday ones too. Competitive salary Equity scheme - we all share in Motorway's success 25 days holiday Flexible working (2 days a week in our London office, with socials and snacks galore) Private medical insurance via BUPA Life assurance Pension scheme (we contribute 5%) Enhanced family leave (e.g. 26 weeks full pay for maternity or adoption) 24/7 Emplo

The business leads the way in delivering safe and secure operating systems, hypervisors, middleware, solutions, and development tools, along with support and services delivered by trusted embedded software experts. With a focus on reducing hardware dependency and increasing efficiency, QNX empowers organizations to unlock new possibilities in areas like high-performance computing at the edge, standards-based virtualization technologies, and cloud enablement. QNX® technology has been deployed in the world’s most critical embedded systems, including more than 275 million vehicles on the road today. QNX® software is trusted across industries including automotive, medical devices, industrial controls, robotics, commercial vehicles, rail, and aerospace and defense. Purpose of the Role: The "QNX Everywhere" Initiative QNX is on a mission to compete directly with Linux as the premier, go-to operating system for embedded development worldwide. Through our QNX Everywhere initiative, we are building a rich, seamless open-source ecosystem that brings the vast array of open-source software currently enjoyed on Linux natively onto the QNX Real-Time Operating System (RTOS). As an Open-Source Software Developer, you will play a pivotal role in this initiative. You will analyze, port, optimize, and upstream a wide range of open-source software — spanning core system utilities, networking middleware, IPC frameworks, middleware stacks, applications, AI frameworks, and bleeding-edge Physical AI Robotics stacks. By bringing these technologies to QNX, you will enable developers globally to build safe, secure, and feature-rich embedded solutions without sacrificing the rich open-source ecosystem. You will conduct: Broad Open-Source Porting Integration: Analyze, port, build, and optimize open-source software across C, C++, Python, and Rust for the QNX RTOS. Projects span a wide variety of domains, including: System Runtimes: Node.js, GTK, SQLite, Boost. Networking Middleware: SOME/IP, MQTT, DDS, Zenoh. Physical AI Robotics: ROS2, OpenPI, Google MediaPipe, OpenCV, ONNX Runtime, PyTorch/ExecuTorch, TensorFlow. Upstreaming Community Leadership: Work directly with upstream open-source communities and maintainers to integrate QNX build targets, patches, and CI configurations into mainstream repositories. Hardware Accelerator Enablement: Work with silicon partners to enable open-source software on diverse embedded platforms, including GPU/NPU acceleration blocks ( NVIDIA IGX Thor, AMD ROCm , Qualcomm, NXP). QNX Subsystem Integration: Integrate open-source projects with core QNX subsystems (graphics, networking, USB, audio, sensors, and multimedia). Porting Layers Toolchain Support: Develop OS-specific abstraction layers, shims, and porting libraries; adapt cross-compilation build systems (CMake, Meson, Bazel, Cargo, GN/Ninja) for QNX toolchains. Performance Optimization: Perform low-level profiling, memory footprint reduction, latency tuning, and performance optimization on embedded target hardware. You will have: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, or equivalent practical experience. Strong software development skills in C and C++ (C++14/17/20) and Python. Proven experience with Linux/Unix development environments and cross-compilation toolchains (CMake, Meson, Ninja, Make). Solid understanding of operating system internals and POSIX APIs (pthreads, IPC, memory management, networking sockets). Excellent communication skills with an interest in collaborating within open-source developer communities. Self-motivated with a passion for building software ecosystems. Any of the below are considered a bonus: Experience porting, building, or maintaining large open-source projects or Linux distributions. Experience or interest in Physical AI, Robotics, or Vision frameworks (e.g., ROS2, OpenPI, MediaPipe, ONNX Runtime, PyTorch/ExecuTorch, TensorFlow, OpenCV). Experience with GPU / Heterogeneous Compute stacks (NVIDIA CUDA/TensorRT, AMD ROCm, Vulkan Compute, OpenCL) on platforms like NVIDIA Thor/IGX or AMD silicon. Knowledge of embedded GUI engines (Qt, GTK), or automotive/industrial middleware (DDS, SOME/IP, MQTT). Hands-on experience with RTOS environments (QNX, VxWorks, FreeRTOS, Zephyr) or Linux kernel/driver internals. Familiarity with Rust and cargo build targets for embedded or systems programming. Active open-source contributions (GitHub/GitLab profile, upstream PRs, or patch submissions). If you are ready to use your expertise to drive real innovation, we would love to hear from you! #LI-KH1 Scheduled Weekly Hours: 40 Compensation Hiring Base Salary Range: $80,000.00 - $105,000.00 Please be advised that the compensation hiring range indicated herein is provided solely as a good-faith estimate of expected base compensation for the position. 8c9206af-791c-43de-a648-2e50a3be300b.title: AI Solutions Analyst
8c9206af-791c-43de-a648-2e50a3be300b.description: WisdomTree is seeking an early-career AI Solutions Analyst to help develop and support practical AI solutions across the firm. This role is ideal for a recent graduate or candidate with 1+ years of experience who is highly fluent in modern AI tools and excited to help translate business needs into lightweight, scalable AI workflows and solutions. This person will support a mix of AI initiatives, including custom GPT and app creation, workflow automation, prompt development, experimentation with agent-based tools and platforms, and support for user-facing AI solutions. The role will work across functions to identify opportunities, prototype solutions, document best practices, and support tools such as ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot, Power Apps, Power Automate, Copilot Studio, and Azure AI / Microsoft Foundry-based solutions. This role is well suited for someone who is curious, adaptable, technically comfortable, and able to translate between business needs and emerging AI capabilities. The individual will support WisdomTree’s growing AI program and work closely with the firm’s AI Tech & Operations leadership and the AI Enablement Analyst to help execute AI initiatives across training, workflow design, solution development, and user adoption. While the position has a primary emphasis on enablement, training, adoption, and business engagement, the individual will be cross-trained across solution-building activities and expected to contribute broadly across the team’s AI initiatives. This role is open to candidates located in the greater New York metropolitan area or within a commutable distance. Success in this role would be achieved by: Help build and maintain lightweight AI solutions, including custom GPTs, internal assistants, automations, workflow prototypes, and Microsoft-based business solutions Assist with experimentation and early development of agent-based use cases, including solutions built within Microsoft Azure / Microsoft Foundry environments Help design, test, and refine prompts, reusable workflows, and AI playbooks Partner with internal stakeholders to identify repetitive tasks and opportunities for AI-assisted automation Build and support AI-enabled workflows and lightweight business solutions using tools such as Power Apps, Power Automate, Copilot Studio, custom GPTs, and related platforms Support testing, QA, and iterative improvement of AI tools and workflows Create documentation, technical notes, and user-friendly guidance to support solution deployment and adoption Assist with evaluating new AI tools, platforms, and use cases for business applicability Help evaluate AI outputs, workflows, and automations for quality, reliability, and business usefulness Help track AI requests, pilot activity, enhancement opportunities, and follow-up items across projects Exercise sound judgment when working with confidential information, internal processes, and AI-generated outputs Work with the AI Enablement Analyst to support training sessions, demos, office hours, and user rollout activities Track common issues, user feedback, and improvement opportunities to enhance solution quality and usability Assist with governance-oriented practices such as validating outputs, monitoring usability, and promoting responsible AI use Support cross-functional AI projects from idea stage through pilot deployment Build familiarity over time with training delivery, end-user support, adoption strategies, and business-facing enablement Experience and required skill set: Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience Strong familiarity with widely used AI tools such as ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot, Claude, Gemini, or similar platforms Familiarity with Microsoft productivity and automation tools, including Power Apps, Power Automate, Copilot, or similar platforms Clear interest in applied AI, workflow improvement, solution development, and business enablement Strong written and verbal communication skills Ability to translate business needs into practical technical approaches Comfort learning new platforms quickly in a fast-changing environment Strong organization, documentation, and follow-through Analytical mindset with good judgment and attention to detail
8c9206af-791c-43de-a648-2e50a3be300b.fit_reason: Low-code AI enablement/business-analyst role (Power Apps, Power Automate, Copilot Studio, prompt writing, training/adoption) that uses none of the candidate's backend, distributed-systems, or AI-infra engineering depth, and its 1+ years immediate-hire framing conflicts with a May 2027 new-grad start.
8c9206af-791c-43de-a648-2e50a3be300b.tc_basis: WisdomTree is a mid-size NYC-based ETF/asset manager; buy-side firms pay well for engineering, but this is scoped as an analyst/enablement seat rather than SWE, so comp likely sits in the NYC analyst range (~$85-105k base plus modest bonus) rather than an engineering band. Wide band, moderate confidence — no public new-grad data for this specific title.

Virtually every electronic device in the world is produced using our technologies. No laptop, smartphone, wearable device, voice-controlled gadget, flexible screen, VR device or smart car would have made it into your hands without us. KLA invents systems and solutions for the manufacturing of wafers and reticles, integrated circuits, packaging, printed circuit boards and flat panel displays. The innovative ideas and devices that are advancing humanity all begin with inspiration, research and development. KLA focuses more than average on innovation and we invest 15% of sales back into R D. Our expert teams of physicists, engineers, data scientists and problem-solvers work together with the world’s leading technology providers to accelerate the delivery of tomorrow’s electronic devices. Life here is exciting and our teams thrive on tackling really hard problems. There is never a dull moment with us. Group/Division With over 40 years of semiconductor process control experience, chipmakers around the globe rely on KLA to ensure that their fabs ramp next-generation devices to volume production quickly and cost-effectively. Enabling the movement towards advanced chip design, KLA's Global Products Group (GPG), which is responsible for creating all of KLA’s metrology and inspection products, is looking for the best and the brightest research scientist, software engineers, application development engineers, and senior product technology process engineers. Central Engineering is KLA's largest engineering organization comprised of 9 Centers-of-Excellence (CoE) in various disciplines applied across all product groups in the company. These CoE include Handling Automation, Precision Motion Control, Sensors Image Acquisition, Platform Design, and Packaging Engineering, among others. Talent includes over 500 engineers across global centers in Israel, China, India, and the US. Each CoE contributes not just talent and deliverables per discipline toward product programs, but also subject matter expertise, best practices, roadmaps, specialized facilities, apparatus, models, and analytics. These differentiate KLA not only in WHAT we do, but also in HOW we do it. Job Description/Preferred Qualifications Job Description/Responsibilities KLA is looking for a Product Development Engineer to support electron beam based metrology instruments developed in our engineering group in Ann Arbor. The engineer will work within a cross-functional team developing the next generation of KLA metrology tools! In this role the candidate will be responsible for: Develop detailed requirement specifications from performance requirements using systems engineering methodology. Work with a team to develop and implement innovative design improvements to currently released products as well as development of novel next generation products. Apply systems engineering principles to optimize critical systems-level instrument performance. Test and validate systems design improvements. Draft documentation for assembly and training procedures. Drive troubleshooting of field customer concerns of sophisticated system performance problems, by providing written plans of action remotely or provide active technical leadership on-site at customer sites worldwide. Interface closely with service, manufacturing and marketing teams to define and optimize system performance and resolve performance issues. Write high-level technical reports to communicate issues, analysis, technical assessments, system status, best-known-methods, and engineering recommendations. Design and drive multi-disciplinary experiments, write detailed test plans for systems testing. Coordinate with outside vendors to develop and deliver sub-system products. Qualifications/Education Desired Have a solid understanding of precision instruments and control systems. Must have solid track record of problem solving. Experience with high vacuum systems. Experience with electron beam based instruments such as scanning electron microscopes. Have excellent oral and written communication, organizational and analytical skills. Previous experience with process control instrument systems for semiconductor industry is preferred. Travel for training and for support of customers worldwide is required. The range displayed reflects the pay for this position in the primary location identified in this posting. Actual pay depends on several factors, including state minimum pay wage rates, location, job-related skills, experience, and relevant education level or training. ASE engages with the entire lifecycle of next-generation AI supercomputing pre-clusters at scale. The team creates reference architectures, confirms feasibility through initial end-to-end integration and bring-up, and supports large-scale production environments. These environments allow internal teams to run workloads, gather detailed telemetry, and detect and resolve issues before they impact customers. As an Applied Systems Engineering Rotation Engineer, you will move through different teams such as Architecture, Bring-up, and Production. Exposure to software, performance, or technical program management teams is possible when program needs align. Throughout four 3-month rotations, you will collaborate with senior engineers and mentors on projects that help NVIDIA design, integrate, validate, operate, and improve large-scale GPU compute clusters. This program is intended for New College Graduates who are curious, systems-minded, and eager to learn how architecture decisions become production-ready clusters. At the end of the year, final placement will be based on a combination of business need, host manager feedback, demonstrated strengths, and candidate preference. What you’ll be doing: Contribute to system-level designs for large-scale accelerated computing environments, including reusable reference architectures and deployment-specific solutions. Evaluate, prototype, and validate emerging infrastructure, hardware, software, firmware, networking, storage, and accelerator technologies. Support end-to-end system integration, bring-up, validation, and production-readiness activities across cross-functional engineering teams. Define, document, and communicate engineering requirements, design tradeoffs, debug methods, findings, and recommendations. Analyze workload, telemetry, performance, reliability, and operational data to identify issues and improvement opportunities. Build or improve dashboards, automation, tools, and workflows that support issue detection, diagnosis, recovery, and technical decision-making. Present technical work and communicate risks, blockers, status, and recommendations through design reviews, project readouts, and cross-functional forums. What we need to see: Bachelor’s degree or Master’s degree or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Systems Engineering, Data Science, Mathematics, Physics, or a related technical field. Ability to analyze technical data, identify patterns, summarize findings, and communicate conclusions clearly. Interest in large-scale systems, AI infrastructure, datacenter systems, hardware/software integration, or distributed computing. Strong collaboration and communication skills, with a willingness to ask questions, learn quickly, and work across engineering teams. 54cabb56-5337-4344-9f40-9ad54dc468b3.description: New College Grad - Product Test Engineer Skip to main content Careers at Micron English Sign In Careers New College Grad - Product Test Engineer page is loaded New College Grad - Product Test Engineer Apply locations Boise, ID - Main Site time type Full time posted on Posted 6 Days Ago job requisition id JR109985 Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for all . Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever. Do you love the interaction of cutting-edge hardware and innovative software solutions? In today's data economy, Micron's memory and storage products are essential to advancing state of the art computing technology. Continued scaling of memory technology presents challenges that require complex and creative testing solutions. As a Product Test Engineer, you will be responsible for the development, debug and maintenance of test programs that help deliver Micron's world-class DRAM portfolio to market. A product test engineer can be focused on the health and quality of the memory cells [DRAM features 16 billion cells in less than 80mm^2 of area] or focused on high-speed interface, AI proficiency, AI supported workflow automation, and system level application testing. Responsibilities Develop, debug and support test programs from new product introduction phase up through high volume manufacturing Write test programs and support scripts in C++, Python Contribute input and feedback to help define next generation 'design for test' capabilities Analyze device and test flow data to make informed test coverage decisions Balance test time objectives while maintaining optimal yield and quality Collaborate with partners in Design and Product Engineering, Fab, Manufacturing, Yield Enhancement, Global Quality, Systems Integration Group, and Equipment Engineering teams to deliver the right test solution Minimum Qualifications Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science or a related discipline Basic R/L/C circuit knowledge Digital systems and logic gate representation Understanding of CMOS transistor operation Basic statistics and data analytics Preferred Qualifications Intermediate to advanced programming capability [C++ or Python] Basic Unix / Linux environment Excellent communication and interpersonal skills Familiarity with AI coding assistance, AI skill generation, and AI workflow automation As a world leader in the semiconductor industry, Micron is dedicated to your personal wellbeing and professional growth. Micron benefits are designed to help you stay well, provide peace of mind and help you prepare for the future. We offer a choice of medical, dental and vision plans in all locations enabling team members to select the plans that best meet their family healthcare needs and budget. Micron also provides benefit programs that help protect your income if you are unable to work due to illness or injury, and paid family leave. Additionally, Micron benefits include a robust paid time-off program and paid holidays. AI-Augmented Software Engineer Full-time Company Description PQ is a leading global provider of silicates, silicas and derivative products. PQ's products are used in a wide variety of industrial processes and many customer products, from decorative paints to green cement, from clean drinking water to green tires and from toothpaste to biofuels and beer. Ideal candidates resonate with PQ's Core Values of Integrity, Sustainability, People, Customer Focus and Safety. Successful employees embrace and model these values in their behaviors and actions. You do not need to be an AI expert, but you should be interested in learning how AI can be integrated into applications, workflows, and business processes. Product Safety Engineer Full-time Compensation: USD 68,000 - USD 88,000 - yearly Company Description Eurofins Scientific is an international life sciences company, providing a unique range of analytical testing services to clients across multiple industries, to make life and our environment safer, healthier and more sustainable. From the food you eat, to the water you drink, to the medicines you rely on, Eurofins works with the biggest companies in the world to ensure the products they supply are safe, their ingredients are authentic and labelling is accurate. Eurofins is the global leader in food, environment, pharmaceutical and cosmetic product testing and in agroscience Contract Research Organisation services. Eurofins is one of the market leaders in certain testing and laboratory services for genomics, discovery pharmacology, forensics, advanced material sciences and in the support of clinical studies, as well as having an emerging global presence in Contract Development and Manufacturing Organisations. The Group also has a rapidly developing presence in highly specialised and molecular clinical diagnostic testing and in-vitro diagnostic products. In over just 30 years, Eurofins has grown from one laboratory in Nantes, France to 55,000 staff across a decentralised and entrepreneurial network of 900 laboratories in over 50 countries. Eurofins offers a portfolio of over 200,000 analytical methods to evaluate the safety, identity, composition, authenticity, origin, traceability and purity of biological substances and products. Job Description Position Summary The Product Safety Engineer, Renewable Energy performs testing and evaluation on a variety of products for conformance to U.S., Canadian and other international product safety standards, writes reports and communicates with clients. This is a full training role for a recent graduate or early-career engineer: under the guidance of a more senior engineer, this role builds a foundation in core product safety testing while training toward supporting the lab's renewable energy program, including inverters, battery energy storage systems and EV equipment. Employee Standards Support department objectives and company goals. Be a team player. Sustain a positive, enthusiastic and professional attitude. Accommodate requests with a can do, let me see what I can do attitude. Adhere to manager directives. Maintain a professional appearance and demeanor. Arrive on time, properly dressed and prepared to work. Perform all duties in a timely, accurate, honest and professional manner. Communicate with customers professionally and in accordance with customer service standards, while maintaining confidentiality. Be receptive to and accepting of guidance from others. Ability to deal with difficult people and problems. Ability to multi task and prioritize assignments. Travel as needed, up to 15%. Set up and operate the EUT; perform and document simple repairs on the EUT as needed. Perform testing of products in accordance with applicable standards. Complete preliminary design reviews (PDR), both on and off site, as experience grows. Develop, set up and follow established test plans. Compile test results during construction review and testing. Compile data and product description and prepare the final report using the established report shell. Submit the report to a reviewer for approval. Communicate project status and test results to clients, sales personnel and management throughout testing. Provide ongoing support to clients as needed. Within policy guidelines, identify, properly document and recommend engineering judgments. Cross train on renewable energy testing disciplines as the program develops, working alongside the Senior Product Safety Engineer, Renewable Energy team. Perform other work as required. Qualifications Bachelor's degree in electrical engineering or a related discipline. 0 to 2 years of experience; recent graduates are encouraged to apply. Coursework, project experience or general interest in power electronics or renewable energy systems is a plus. Proficiency with Microsoft Office. Must possess a valid, unrestricted driver's license and a clean driving record. Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Excellent organizational and time management skills. Excellent customer service skills. Self motivated and able to work independently in a fast paced, multi tasking environment. Ability to travel as business needs dictate, up to 15%. Physical dexterity and mobility to travel by car and airplane and to perform all functions inherent to the position. Able to work with hand tools and small power tools. 551ab6e9-715d-4111-9de9-e888a5dd2718.description: <div class= content-intro ><p>Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.</p></div><p>We are looking for Flight Software Engineers to join our rapidly growing team! We hire self-motivated people, those who hold a higher bar for themselves than anyone else could hold for them. If you are nbsp;eager to solve tough problems, then this role might be for you! nbsp;</p> <p>Our Flight Engineering department is divided into three critical areas: Flight Software (FSW), Guidance, Navigation amp; Control (GNC), and Modeling, Simulation amp; Analysis (MSA). As an entry-level engineer, you ll have the opportunity to work alongside industry experts in one of these areas, contributing to the development and testing of advanced autonomous systems.</p> <p><strong>WHAT YOU’LL DO</strong> nbsp;</p> <ul> <li>Assist in the design and development of flight software algorithms, GNC systems, or simulation models.</li> <li>Participate in the integration and testing of software/hardware components in lab, ground, or flight tests.</li> <li>Analyze data collected from simulations and flight test events to inform system improvements.</li> <li>Collaborate with cross-functional teams to address engineering challenges and enhance system performance.</li> <li>Engage in creative problem-solving to advance our UAS and missile technologies.</li> </ul> <p><strong>REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS</strong> nbsp;</p> <ul> <li>Must be pursuing or have recently completed a nbsp;bachelor’s or nbsp;master’s nbsp;degree in Aerospace Engineering, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field. nbsp;</li> </ul> <ul> <li>Must be a U.S. Person due to required access to U.S. nbsp;export-controlled nbsp;information or facilities; U.S. clearance eligibility may be required depending on program. nbsp;</li> </ul> <ul> <li>Able to start full time in 2027. nbsp;</li> </ul> <p><strong>PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS</strong> nbsp;</p> <ul> <li>A strong foundation in software development (for FSW candidates), control theory (for GNC candidates), or analytical modeling (for MSA candidates).</li> <li>Keen interest in autonomous systems, UAS, and missile technology.</li> <li>Excellent communication, teamwork, and problem-solving skills.</li> <li>Hands-on experience with Design-Build-Fly teams, robotics competition teams (such as FIRST or VEX), or collegiate rocketry groups.</li> <li>Credible demonstration of aerospace-related hobbies such as high-power rocketry experience/certification, remotely piloted/semi-autonomous aircraft, or software integration on target hardware such as Raspberry Pi, Pixhawk, CubePilot (such as Cube Orange), or custom microcontrollers, using onboard IMU, GNSS, and Flight Simulation, Software-in-the-Loop (SITL) or Hardware-in-the-Loop (HITL) simulation environments.</li> <li>Experience with open-source autopilot software suites like ArduPilot or PX4.</li> <li>Experience with integrating flight hardware components including servos/actuators, IMUs, magnetometers, GNSS receivers and antennas, and serial communication protocols (such as UART, CAN, I2C, SPI) or radio telemetry links.</li> <li>Basic familiarity with electrical test equipment (such as multimeters or oscilloscopes) and post-flight data analysis using tools like Python or MATLAB.</li> </ul><div class= content-pay-transparency ><div class= pay-input ><div class= title >US Salary Range</div><div class= pay-range ><span>$112,000</span><span class= divider > mdash;</span><span>$149,000 USD</span></div></div></div><div class= content-conclusion ><p><span data-contrast= auto >The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril s total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:</span><span data-ccp-props= { quot;134233117 quot;:false, quot;134233118 quot;:false, quot;335551550 quot;:0, quot;335551620 quot;:0, quot;335559738 quot;:240, quot;335559739 quot;:240} > nbsp;</span></p> <p> nbsp;</p> <h3 class= detailElios ><strong>Benefits</strong></h3> <p><span data-contrast= auto >At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. nbsp;</span><em><span data-contrast= auto >For more information, <a href= https://www.anduril.com/careers >Explore Our Benefits</a>.</span></em></p> <p&gt

(New Head Count) AI Disclosure: As part of the application process, Artificial Intelligence will be used in the hiring process for this role. Work Arrangement Hybrid: This role is categorized as hybrid. This means the successful candidate is expected to report to Markham Elevation Centre (MEC) three times per week at minimum, or other frequency dictated by the business. The Role: We are looking for a new graduate Software Developer with an interest in distributed systems and fleet scale device management to help build, test, and maintain our embedded control and data plane infrastructure. This is a great opportunity to start your career working on software that runs across GM's entire vehicle fleet, with direct mentorship from senior engineers on the team. The ideal candidate has a strong foundation in software development (C/C++) from coursework, internships, or personal projects, hands on experience from a collegiate engineering design team such as Formula SAE, SAE AutoDrive Challenge, or EcoCAR, curiosity about open source technologies, and an eagerness to learn how production grade software is designed, tested, and supported. About the Team: The Device Data Capture Organization builds the embedded and cloud software that moves data off GM's vehicles and configuration onto them. Our data plane runs on the vehicle's ECUs collecting and uploading data, and our control plane pushes configuration out to the fleet from the cloud. Teams across GM rely on this, from Super Cruise and AV engineers training models to quality teams diagnosing field issues. Key Responsibilities: Design, implement, and maintain the on vehicle control plane that retrieves configuration from the cloud and applies it across the vehicle's ECUs. Design, implement, and maintain the on vehicle data plane that collects, processes, and forwards data from vehicle systems to cloud storage. Contribute to optimizing our control and data plane for reliable data egress and configuration delivery over intermittent connectivity, rapid convergence to new configuration, and a minimal CPU and memory footprint on the target ECU. Work with cloud services such as Azure, AWS S3, and Firestore for configuration delivery, device state reporting, and data egress. Collaborate with DevOps and Cloud teams to help roll out new on vehicle software and configuration safely. Instrument our software with the observability needed to monitor the fleet, diagnose issues in production, and resolve them at the source. Contribute to the open source community by reporting issues, contributing to documentation, and submitting patches. Foundational understanding of distributed systems, configuration management, or data pipelines, gained through coursework or projects. Strong problem solving skills and a willingness to dig into and troubleshoot complex issues. Excellent communication skills and the ability to work effectively in a team environment. Eagerness to learn how to deliver and support software in a production environment. Familiarity with vehicle communication protocols (UDS, CAN, SOME/IP, XCP) or Autosar standards. Understanding of network communication and security protocols, including mTLS and certificate based device identity. Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure) and their device management services (IoT Hub, IoT Core, Pub/Sub, or equivalent). Familiarity with OpenTelemetry. Internship or project experience with fleet management, OTA, or remote configuration systems, or contributions to Fluent Bit or other data intensive open source projects. Experience working with Firestore. Exposure to CI/CD pipelines and automation tools. Compensation: The salary range for this role is $73,900 to $110,900. The actual base salary a successful candidate will be offered within this range will vary based on factors relevant to the position. f4f63dfa-3cc3-4d63-bbe5-da2f63af5c94.title: Optical System Integration Engineer - System Optics
f4f63dfa-3cc3-4d63-bbe5-da2f63af5c94.description: Optical System Integration Engineer Careers Optical System Integration Engineer Optical System Integration Engineer About the role We are seeking a motivated and hands-on Optical System Integration Engineer to join our System Optics Team. The team is responsible for integrating and validating optical subsystems and ensuring product performance from an optical standpoint. This is a hands-on engineering role intended for a recent graduate, or early-career engineer with strong fundamentals in optics and an interest in building, testing, and debugging real optical systems. What you'll do Build, align, and characterize optical laboratory setups and optical subsystems. Support testing and validation of optical components and subsystems, including lenses, windows, mirrors, lasers, detectors, and related opto-mechanical assemblies. Perform optical alignment tasks including free-space alignment, beam collimation, focusing, and optimization of optical paths. Execute optical characterization and system-level test procedures and analyze the resulting data. Develop Python scripts for instrument control, test automation, data processing, visualization, and analysis. Assist with development and validation new sensor prototyping and manufacturing processes. Support optical subsystem bring-up, integration, validation, and troubleshooting. Investigate unexpected system behavior using experimental data and fundamental engineering principles. Perform measurements and characterization of optical performance, including beam profile, M², wavefront error (WFE), and other relevant optical metrics. Work with cross-functional engineering teams, including electrical, firmware, DSP, software, and mechanical engineering. Document experimental setups, procedures, results, and conclusions clearly. Participate in failure analysis and root-cause investigations with experienced engineers. Propose improvements to optical setups, test methods, automation, and measurement techniques. Required Qualifications A B.S. or M.S. in Optical/Photonics Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Physics, Applied Physics, or a related engineering field. Strong understanding of optical fundamentals, including geometric optics, lenses, imaging, Gaussian beams, diffraction, and basic physical optics. Demonstrated hands-on technical aptitude through laboratory coursework, research, internships, engineering projects, or previous employment. Comfortable working with physical hardware and performing iterative setup, measurement, alignment, and debugging. Experience with or strong interest in: Free-space optical alignment ; Lenses and opto-mechanical components ; Laser alignment and beam collimation ; Photodetectors and optical power measurements ; Optical and electrical laboratory instrumentation ; Optical systems in sensing applications Working knowledge of Python, particularly for scientific computing, data analysis, or laboratory automation. Ability to analyze experimental data, identify trends or anomalies, and develop hypotheses based on measurement results. Strong problem-solving skills and willingness to learn unfamiliar systems and measurement techniques. Ability to communicate technical observations and results clearly. Preferred Qualifications Python libraries such as NumPy, SciPy, pandas, and Matplotlib. Automated test equipment and instrument communication/control. Passive or active integrated photonics testing. Basic analog/digital electronics and ability to interpret circuit schematics or system block diagrams. Optical simulation or design tools such as Zemax OpticStudio, Code V, or similar software. FPGA or SoC-based hardware platforms. Benefits (subject to location and local regulations) Competitive salary and equity Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage 401(k) retirement plan Flexible vacation and time-off policy Collaborative, fast-paced, and inclusive work environment Opportunity to work on cutting-edge technologies with a highly cross-functional team About Lyte Lyte builds perception systems for Physical AI operating in complex environments. The company combines custom silicon, integrated sensors, and software into a unified platform for robotics, mobility, and next-generation automation. Lyte is headquartered in Sunnyvale, California, with a global presence. For more information, visit www.lyte.ai If you’re excited about building impactful technology in a dynamic, hands-on environment, we’d love to hear from you!
