b70dd956-6085-4758-b5b8-1a3509421369.title: Junior Software Engineer
b70dd956-6085-4758-b5b8-1a3509421369.description: Are you ready to embark on a career that truly affects people around the world? Trulioo invites you to be a catalyst for change in the dynamic realm of digital identity verification. As the global front-runner in our industry, we are redefining how businesses grow, innovate and comply online. Picture yourself at the forefront of innovation, contributing to our award-winning platform that enables organizations worldwide to quickly onboard customers, optimize costs and combat fraud. Fueled by Silicon Valley support, Trulioo stands as the trusted platform that can verify more than 5 billion people and 700 million business entities spanning 195 countries. But Trulioo is more than a tech company. We are a united force of dedicated experts committed to establishing trust online - and we’re proud to be recognized as a BC Top Employer for the second consecutive year , reflecting our commitment to an inclusive, collaborative, and people-first workplace. Headquartered in Vancouver and with strategic hubs in San Diego and Dublin, we foster a culture of collaboration and open communication. Our offices support a hybrid model and staff typically work three days per week at a hub location. Join us where excitement meets innovation and contribute to a world where trust and technology unite. What We Offer Comprehensive Benefits: We provide a robust benefits package for full-time, permanent employees, including health, dental, and vision coverage, retirement plans with company match, paid time off, parental leave, and an annual education training stipend (equivalent to $1,000 in local currency). Specific benefits may vary by location and will be discussed further during the interview process. Flexible Hybrid Working Environment: Our offices are designed to support both collaboration and flexibility. Enjoy weekly lunches, quality coffee, and regular social events. Many locations also feature parent rooms, on-site gyms, comfortable lounges, and adaptable workstations to support your comfort and productivity. Wellness: We care about your well-being. Team members have access to wellness workshops and events, as well as a complimentary Headspace subscription to help you stay focused, grounded, and energized. Employee Resource Groups: Belonging is an important part of doing your best work. Our ERGs provide an inclusive space, support and community for employees of diverse backgrounds and allies. We host informative, fun sessions and celebrations that are often open to the entire organization. Position Summary: We're looking for a Junior Software Engineer to help take various Agentic verification capabilities from proof-of-concept to a real, production system. This is a great fit for a recent or soon-to-graduate Master's student who has spent their program building real projects with modern AI tools — not just using ChatGPT, but experimenting with coding assistants and building agent-style projects on your own initiative. We're not expecting years of professional AI experience. We're looking for people who are curious, self-driven, and have already started exploring this space through coursework, personal projects, or hackathons, and who want to keep building in a production environment. This role is expected to leverage AI and emerging technologies to improve productivity, enhance decision-making, and continuously optimize how work is performed. This will be a full-time, permanent position working out of the San Diego office on a hybrid model (3-days per week in the office). What You'll Be Doing: Help take various Discovery Agent prototypes (e.g. Vertex AI-based) through the SDLC — contributing to design, implementation, testing, and deployment (via API and Agentic access). Help harden POC-quality agent code toward production quality: error handling, observability, testing, and basic cost/latency awareness. Help build test cases and evaluation checks for agent behavior — an important and different skill from testing traditional deterministic code. Support data ingestion and pipeline work feeding the agent, using AWS/BigData tooling. Work with Product team and senior engineers to turn business requirements into shipped features. Learn and contribute to production support practices: monitoring, alerting, and incident response for an AI-driven service. What You’ll Bring: 1-2 years of experience working in a software engineering or development environment. Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, or a closely related field. Solid foundation in Python and/or another backend language, with the ability to write clean, readable, testable code. Understanding of SQL and/or NoSQL databases, and basic API design (REST at minimum). Exposure to cloud infrastructure (AWS preferred) — coursework, internship, or personal project experience is fine. Some exposure to data pipelines or data processing (e.g., via coursework, internships, or projects using tools like PySpark, Airflow, or similar) is a plus, not a requirement. A self-starter mindset — comfortable with ambiguity, asking good questions, and figuring things out rather than waiting for a fully specified task. Genuinely excited about working with the newest AI tooling — you've already been experimenting with it because you wanted to, not because a class required it. Driven to actually ship usable products: you'd rather get a real project working end-to-end than perfect just one piece of it. Eager to learn how production systems really work — testing, deployment, monitoring, on-call support and troubleshooting— beyond what a class or internship typically covers. A good collaborator who communicates clearly and is comfortable working alongside more senior engineers. Bonus (Nice to Have, Not Required) Coursework or projects touching orchestration tools (Apache Airflow, Dagster), OpenSearch/Elasticsearch, or BigData tools (Spark, Presto/Trino, Hive). Familiarity with TypeScript/React/Node.js for full-stack project work. Exposure to infrastructure-as-co
b70dd956-6085-4758-b5b8-1a3509421369.fit_reason: Strong topical overlap with the candidate's agentic-AI/production-LLM-infra and Python/AWS backend strengths, but it's a near-term junior req wanting a Master's plus 1-2 years of experience, is hybrid in San Diego, and has no distributed-systems depth — so timing and level fit poorly against a May 2027 new-grad start.
b70dd956-6085-4758-b5b8-1a3509421369.tc_basis: Estimate, not fact. Trulioo is a private mid-tier identity-verification company (Vancouver HQ, San Diego hub, VC-backed) rather than a top-paying tech employer; a junior/entry SWE in San Diego most likely sees ~$100-115k base plus a modest bonus and illiquid equity. Band is widened because Trulioo publishes no leveled comp data. This falls at or below the candidate's ~$130k anchor.

afa6e892-ee06-4fbc-917b-d6376b37e6fc.description: <div class= content-intro ><div> <div> nbsp;</div> <div>At Accenture Federal Services, nothing matters more than helping the US federal government make the nation stronger and safer and life better for people. Our 13,000+ people are united in a shared purpose to pursue the limitless potential of technology and ingenuity for clients across defense, national security, public safety, civilian, and military health organizations. nbsp;</div> <div> nbsp;</div> <div>Join Accenture Federal Services, a technology company within global Accenture. Recognized as a Glassdoor Top 100 Best Place to Work, we offer a collaborative and caring community where you feel like you belong and are empowered to grow, learn and thrive through hands-on experience, certifications, industry training and more. nbsp;</div> <div> nbsp;</div> <div>Join us to drive positive, lasting change that moves missions and the government forward!</div> <div> nbsp;</div> </div></div><p>AFS is searching for a Data Engineer to support the design, development, and maintenance of data pipelines, data models, and analytics platforms. This role is ideal for individuals who are beginning their data engineering career and eager to work with modern cloud, ETL, and automation technologies in a collaborative environment.</p> <p><strong>Responsibilities </strong></p> <ul> <li>Data pipeline development, build, test, and maintain scalable data ingestion and transformation pipelines. nbsp;</li> <li>Support ETL/ELT activities to move data from source systems to analytics environments.</li> <li>Ensure data workflows are reliable, monitored, and well‑documented.</li> <li>Data Modeling amp; Warehousing to assist in designing and maintaining structured datasets for analytics, reporting, and machine learning use cases.</li> <li>Help define data models, schemas, and metadata within governed data environments.</li> <li>Data Quality amp; As an Analog Design Engineer you will create integrated circuit designs that help bring new TI products to life and make our customers' visions a reality. You'll define, design, model, implement and document analog, digital and/or RF integrated circuits (ICs). 304431b8-759b-4177-ab0b-ffd57eb218f3.title: Robotics Engineer - Motion Planning
304431b8-759b-4177-ab0b-ffd57eb218f3.description: Join Contoro Robotics – Revolutionizing Warehouse Automation with Cutting-Edge Robotics At Contoro Robotics , we're on a mission to solve labor challenges through advanced robotic solutions. Headquartered in Austin, TX , our fast-growing startup is transforming the supply chain industry with our flagship warehouse automation technology. Our team is made up of top-tier experts in robotics, AI, and logistics , working together to push the boundaries of automation. We’re looking for talented and ambitious individuals to join us on this journey—helping shape the future of robotics while growing alongside a world-class team. If you're passionate about innovation, problem-solving, and making a real-world impact, we want to hear from you! Robotics Engineer, Motion Planning Contoro Robotics is an Austin-based company building autonomous truck-unloading robots for warehouse operations. We deploy reliable, high-throughput robotic systems that handle heavy, unstructured freight in real logistics settings every day. The Role We are looking for a Robotics Engineer to help improve the reliability and performance of our robot's motion-planning stack on a live production fleet. A significant part of this role is hands-on production support: reproducing field issues, debugging them across motion planning, perception, and controls, and validating fixes on real hardware. You will work closely with our senior motion-planning and autonomy engineers, tuning and integrating motion planning as you grow your depth in the field. Responsibilities Production Debugging and Performance Support Investigate and help resolve production issues that affect cycle time, pick success, and operator intervention rate, working across motion planning, perception, and controls to find root cause. Reproduce field failures on real hardware, analyze logs and telemetry, and work with senior engineers to validate root cause and ship fixes. Motion Planning Implementation and Integration Implement and tune planners within the MoveIt ecosystem for collision-free, kinematically feasible motion, with guidance from senior engineers. Integrate perception outputs (container frame, box poses, occupancy) into the planning scene, reasoning about collision objects such as container walls, ceiling, and neighboring boxes. Integrate path and trajectory generation with the control stack (MoveIt and ros_control), and measure cycle-time and throughput impact on hardware. Hardware Validation Run controlled tests on the robot, compare before-and-after throughput, and quantify the impact of changes across diverse box and container configurations. Collaborate across autonomy, perception, controls, and robot software to deliver reliable end-to-end motion. Qualifications Experience: 1-3 years of professional experience (or equivalent research or internship experience) in motion planning, manipulator control, or robotics software, ideally with real-hardware exposure. Strong recent graduates with excellent fundamentals are encouraged to apply. Education: Minimum B.S. in Robotics, Computer Science, Mechanical/Electrical Engineering, or a related field. Technical Skills: Proficient in C++ (modern standards), Python, and ROS 1 or ROS 2. Working knowledge of MoveIt and at least one motion planning approach (e.g., sampling-based planners such as RRT/RRT-Connect/PRM, or optimization-based planners such as CHOMP/TrajOpt). Solid grasp of manipulator kinematics - forward/inverse kinematics, collision checking, velocity and acceleration limits, and singularity and joint-limit awareness for 6/7-DOF arms. Strong debugging instincts and a willingness to dig into hard, ambiguous production issues. Good communication and eagerness to learn from senior engineers. Nice to Have Hands-on experience with industrial manipulators (e.g., UR, KUKA) and real-time joint control. Familiarity with integrating perception inputs (point clouds, object poses, occupancy maps) into collision-aware planning. Exposure to time-parameterization tools (TOTG/TOPP-RA, Ruckig, jerk-limited/S-curve profiles). A controls or electrical background (motor limits, torque, current) useful for hardware-level debugging. Exposure to physics-based or kinematic simulation (Isaac Sim, Gazebo, MuJoCo, Bullet). *Recruitment Agencies: Please do not contact our employees regarding this role. We partner with a select group of approved recruiting firms and do not accept unsolicited outreach or candidate submissions.

This role is responsible for bringing together perception, localization, planning, locomotion, manipulation, controls, sensors, compute, networking, diagnostics, and release workflows. What You'll Do Integrate humanoid subsystems into a reliable full-stack robot system running on physical hardware. Define and maintain interfaces across autonomy, manipulation, locomotion, sensors, compute, controls, and field tools. Own robot bring-up, calibration, configuration, diagnostics, and validation workflows. Debug system-level issues across software, hardware, networking, timing, compute constraints, sensor data, and robot behavior. Develop integration tests, regression tests, telemetry tools, dashboards, and release-readiness checks. Partner with manipulation, hardware, QA/QC, field application, and service teams to keep humanoid platforms continuously shippable. Harden research or prototype capabilities into maintainable, testable, deployment-ready modules. What You Bring MS or PhD in Robotics, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field preferred; BS considered with a demonstrated track record of hands-on robotics work across multiple physical systems — research projects, competition robotics, or internships with daily hardware exposure. Background appropriate for a junior-to-mid engineer; fresh MS and PhD graduates welcome. Strong hands-on experience integrating robotic systems on real hardware — must include physical hardware; simulation-only backgrounds will not be considered. Strong C++ and Python skills in Linux-based robotics environments. Experience with ROS/ROS2, robot middleware, drivers, calibration, diagnostics, logging, and distributed systems. Understanding of perception, planning, controls, locomotion, manipulation, sensor integration, and embedded compute constraints. Ability to profile performance, isolate failures, define interfaces, and coordinate across multiple technical teams. What Sets You Apart You've integrated a humanoid or legged/mobile manipulation platform from bring-up through field deployment — not just research or simulation. You've owned the interfaces between locomotion, manipulation, and perception, and debugged failures across those seams on real hardware. You've built the tooling that made other engineers faster: calibration pipelines, regression harnesses, telemetry dashboards, or release gates that prevented bad deploys. You carry hard-won instincts about what separates a demo-ready system from a deployment-ready one — and you've acted on that distinction.

If you thrive on ownership and solving real problems with real hardware, there’s no better place to be. Job Function: Career Programs Job Sub Function: Post Doc – Data Analytics Computational Sciences Job Category: Career Program All Job Posting Locations: Cambridge, Massachusetts, United States of America, Raritan, New Jersey, United States of America, San Diego, California, United States of America, Spring House, Pennsylvania, United States of America, Titusville, New Jersey, United States of America Job Description: Our expertise in Innovative Medicine is informed and inspired by patients, whose insights fuel our science-based advancements. Visionaries like you work on teams that save lives by developing the medicines of tomorrow. Join us in developing treatments, finding cures, and pioneering the path from lab to life while championing patients every step of the way. Learn more at https://www.jnj.com/innovative-medicine Johnson Johnson Innovative Medicine is seeking a Translational Post Doctoral Researcher — Agentic AI for Neurodegeneration for a 2-year fixed term position. This position can be located in either Raritan NJ, Titusville NJ, Spring House PA, San Diego CA or Cambridge MA. (No fully remote option.) The next frontier in neurodegeneration research is integrating insights across the data we already have at scale with agentic AI in ways which were previously not possible. Whole slide pathology, PET and MRI imaging, multi-omics, and longitudinal clinical records each offer a different lens on the neurodegenerative diseases; brought together, they tell a story no single modality can. This integration challenge is reshaping how we build agentic AI systems for drug discovery and how we evaluate them. Traditional benchmarks were composed for single-modality reasoning. Evaluating whether an AI co-scientist can synthesize across pathology, imaging, molecular, and clinical evidence and produce hypotheses that are biologically sound, demands new frameworks. We are seeking a Postdoctoral Researcher to build them. The Researcher will be embedded in the Machine Intelligence (MI) team at J J Innovative Medicine, working in partnership with the c-brAIn academic network. The role begins with engagement in multi-modal neuroscience data - understanding what each modality reveals, how they relate, and where integration breaks down - and builds toward crafting the evaluation frameworks and standards by which agentic co-scientist systems are tested, validated, and trusted. The Researcher will work day-to-day with AI scientists in J J’s Machine Intelligence group while partnering closely with translational and experimental teams across C-BRAIN’s academic network at Washington University in St. Louis and partner institutions. Mentorship is designed to build leaders at the Multi-Modal Data × AI Evaluation × Neurodegeneration interface, with opportunities for publications, cross-sector exposure, and leadership development. KEY RESPSONSIBILITIES Multi-Modal Data Integration Characterize and integrate biomedical data modalities — digital pathology (whole slide images), neuroimaging (PET, structural and functional MRI), omics (genomics, transcriptomics, proteomics, metabolomics), and longitudinal clinical data to develop specialized, domain-specific models for neurodegeneration Build and refine data engineering pipelines that harmonize heterogeneous modalities — reconciling differences in spatial resolution, temporal scale, and dimensionality — into unified analytical frameworks Identify where cross-modal integration produces genuine insight versus where it introduces noise or artifact, establishing ground truth for downstream AI evaluation Agentic AI Evaluation Critically assess AI-driven literature synthesis and automated “third reviewer” capabilities for detecting methodological weaknesses, logical gaps, and unsupported claims across data modalities Establish standards for how agentic systems incorporate overlooked or contradictory evidence such as negative findings, failed clinical trials, etc. and evaluate whether these integrations generate genuinely novel hypotheses Design evaluation frameworks for agentic AI systems operating across neuroscience data modalities — assessing whether models can reason credibly across imaging, omics, and

99db0e09-f672-4d8a-942d-ea95fb704ed8.tc_basis: Large-pharma industry postdoc fellowships (J&J Innovative Medicine) pay on academic-adjacent scales, roughly $80-105K base with a small bonus; well below the candidate's ~$130K anchor and not a new-grad SWE band.

54311374-2184-4393-8e33-d5b5924fb292.title: Postdoctoral Appointee - AI for Biomedical Discovery
54311374-2184-4393-8e33-d5b5924fb292.description: Postdoctoral Appointee - AI for Biomedical Discovery Skip to main content ARGONNE CAREERS Sign In Careers Home Search for Jobs Introduce Yourself Postdoctoral Appointee - AI for Biomedical Discovery page is loaded Postdoctoral Appointee - AI for Biomedical Discovery Apply locations Lemont, IL USA time type Full time posted on Posted 30+ Days Ago job requisition id 422855 The Argonne team is seeking two highly motivated postdoctoral researchers to help shape the next generation of secure, scalable, and continuously learning AI systems for biomedical discovery. This position will contribute to the Forge project, which is focused on developing advanced multimodal AI capabilities that can learn across distributed data environments without requiring sensitive data to be centralized. The successful candidates will work at the intersection of federated learning, foundation models, multimodal biomedical AI, privacy-preserving machine learning, continuous learning, and agentic AI systems. This is an opportunity to conduct applied research that advances trustworthy AI for biomedical and national security-relevant use cases while working in a multidisciplinary environment that brings together computer scientists, AI researchers, domain scientists, software engineers, and high-performance computing experts. You will help design and implement new methods for multimodal federated learning across heterogeneous data types such as clinical, imaging, omics, text, and experimental data. The work will include developing approaches for continual model improvement, adaptive federated training, model evaluation, workflow automation, and AI-assisted orchestration of distributed learning tasks. The position will also provide opportunities to contribute to open-source software, publish research findings, present at major conferences and workshops, and collaborate with partners across national laboratories, universities, government agencies, and biomedical research organizations. The work will take place in a collaborative, mission-driven research environment that values technical creativity, rigorous engineering, scientific impact, and teamwork. The group works on practical AI systems that connect research prototypes to real-world deployment environments, including cloud, secure enclaves, trusted research environments, and leadership computing platforms. Candidates should be comfortable working in a fast-moving research setting where methods development, software implementation, experimentation, and scientific communication are all important parts of the role. Core Responsibilities: Conduct research and development in federated learning, privacy-preserving machine learning, multimodal AI, and foundation model adaptation for biomedical and related scientific applications. Develop new methods for multimodal federated learning that can integrate information across distributed datasets, including imaging, omics, clinical, text, sensor, and other structured or unstructured data modalities. Design and implement continuous learning approaches that allow models to improve over time as new data, validation results, or experimental feedback become available. Explore agentic AI approaches for federated learning, including AI agents that can assist with task orchestration, experiment planning, model evaluation, workflow automation, and decision support across distributed environments. Build and extend software capabilities in federated learning frameworks, with emphasis on scalable, reproducible, secure, and extensible research software. Evaluate model performance, robustness, generalizability, fairness, privacy, and data readiness across heterogeneous sites and datasets. Contribute to the design of secure AI workflows that may involve trusted research environments, secure enclaves, privacy-preserving computation, differential privacy, secure aggregation, or related techniques. Collaborate with interdisciplinary teams, including AI researchers, biomedical scientists, software engineers, security experts, and high-performance computing specialists. Prepare research results for publication in peer-reviewed conferences and journals, and communicate findings through presentations, technical reports, project meetings, and software documentation. Support project milestones, demonstrations, and deliverables by developing working prototypes, experimental benchmarks, and reusable software components. Position Requirements Required Skills and Qualifications: Ph.D. completed within the last 0–5 years in computer science, data science, biomedical informatics, computational biology, bioengineering, applied mathematics, electrical engineering, or a related field. Strong programming skills in Python and experience developing research or production-quality machine learning software. Experience with machine learning or deep learning frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, JAX, or similar tools. Knowledge of federated learning, distributed machine learning, privacy-preserving AI, foundation models, multimodal learning, continual learning, or related areas. Ability to design and conduct computational experiments, analyze model performance, and communicate results clearly. Experience working with large-scale or complex datasets, including structured, unstructured, multimodal, biomedical, scientific, or high-dimensional data. Ability to work independently while contributing effectively to a multidisciplinary research team. 2869e42a-aa24-4c96-a6af-93fc142804cd.title: Software/Infrastructure Graduate
2869e42a-aa24-4c96-a6af-93fc142804cd.description: <p><strong>Start Date: September 6th 2027</strong></p> <p><strong>About the role</strong></p> <p>This is an 18-24 month programme in our New York office. The successful hire will have the opportunity to work across multiple (up to six) technology teams. The variety of this programme will enable you to build a strong foundation and gain exposure to different technologies, development styles, and areas of our business. nbsp;</p> <ul> <li>The programme takes your input into account; combining your interests with areas where your contribution will make the most impact.</li> <li>The programme includes highly personalised mentoring, regular seminars with senior managers and key staff, social events and opportunities to participate in the firm’s charitable activities.</li> <li>At any time you’ll be working on one or two projects, with direct business impact, in a supportive team that values open communication.</li> </ul> <p><strong> nbsp;</strong><strong>Why join us?</strong></p> <p>You’ll be joining a business where engineering is central to how ideas become outcomes. Our teams build and maintain the platforms, applications and infrastructure that support critical activity across the firm, and we continue to invest heavily in the tools, systems and talent that keep us at the forefront of the industry.</p> <p>This programme offers an excellent starting point for graduates who want to develop breadth as well as depth. By spending time in different engineering environments, you’ll gain insight into a range of technical disciplines, ways of working and business functions. This broader perspective can help you understand where your interests and strengths are best suited, while building a well-rounded foundation for your future career.</p> <p>From the outset, you’ll be trusted to contribute to work that matters. You’ll collaborate with experienced engineers on practical challenges, solve real problems, and see how technology decisions influence the business. Along the way, you’ll strengthen your technical capability, build confidence in a professional environment, and learn how to apply your skills in a setting where performance, innovation and teamwork all matter.</p> <p>You’ll also be supported in your development through close guidance, exposure to experienced colleagues, and opportunities to build connections across the organisation. If you are motivated by learning, enjoy working through complex problems, and want to explore different areas of engineering before choosing a longer-term path, this programme provides a strong platform to do that.</p> <p><span data-ccp-props= { quot;201341983 quot;:0, quot;335559739 quot;:160, quot;335559740 quot;:279} ><em>Marshall Wace is an equal opportunity employer. Individuals seeking employment are considered without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, or any other category protected by applicable law.</em></span></p> <p><span data-ccp-props= { quot;201341983 quot;:0, quot;335559739 quot;:160, quot;335559740 quot;:279} ><em><strong>Note: We request that you only apply to the one role you are most interested in. This includes both the position itself and the location. nbsp;<span style= text-decoration: underline; >Duplicate applications will cause delays in processing your application</span>.</strong></em></span></p> <p><strong><em>In accordance with New York State and New York City pay transparency laws, the annual base salary for this position is $150,000. Actual compensation may vary based on factors such as experience, qualifications, and location. This role may also be eligible for a discretionary bonus and benefits.</em></strong></p> <p> nbsp;</p>
2869e42a-aa24-4c96-a6af-93fc142804cd.fit_reason: A NYC rotational software/infrastructure grad program starting September 2027 lines up almost perfectly with Nate's May 2027 graduation, backend/platform/infra strengths, and location preference — the only softness is the generalist rotational framing rather than a dedicated distributed-systems or AI-infra track.
2869e42a-aa24-4c96-a6af-93fc142804cd.tc_basis: Posting discloses a $150,000 base under NYC pay transparency law, plus a discretionary bonus and benefits. Marshall Wace is a top-tier global hedge fund, and first-year grad bonuses at that tier typically run roughly 25-70% of base, putting realistic first-year TC around $185k-$260k. The bonus is discretionary and firm/performance dependent, so the upper end is uncertain — treat this as an estimate, not a quote.

9ed60305-1668-42f5-a1ee-35ecadf6be12.title: Model Based Systems Engineer
9ed60305-1668-42f5-a1ee-35ecadf6be12.description: Model Based System Engineer-Junior Level - Solvarus - Career Page Skip To Job Description View All Jobs View Our Website Thanks for visiting our Career Page. Please review our open positions and apply to the positions that match your qualifications. Model Based System Engineer-Junior Level Chantilly, VA Full Time Entry Level Share Solvarus Consulting is dedicated to solving the toughest challenges facing the Intelligence Community and Department of Defense. Join our team of experienced engineers in the development and institutionalization of a Digital Engineering environment set to confront these challenges. As a Solvarus team member, you will work closely as part of multiple Integrated Product Teams (IPTs) to architect and design Space and Ground solutions using advanced Model Based Systems Engineering (MBSE) processes and techniques. These solutions will be related to space-to-space as well as ground-to-space communication, processing and command control. You will work with SIGINT and GEOINT subject matter experts to craft MBSE mission-based models. You will be on the team leading the adoption of MBSE in the Intelligence Community. Solvarus also provides team members training towards Object Certified Systems Modeler Professional (OCSMP) certification. Responsibilities : Create engineering artifacts and develop models of mission systems using a MBSE tool suite that includes NoMagic Cameo EA, Rhapsody, Sparx EA as well as other systems engineering tools. Define the appropriate data standards, data structures, and supporting COTS, GOTS, and Open-Source technologies required to manage the data needs. Integrate enterprise tools and develop MBSE-based processes to support requirements engineering, the customer's ERB process, CONOPS and architecture development, Risk, Issues and Opportunity Management boards, schedule management, test and verification strategy development, and system integration of new initiatives in support of expanded mission capabilities. Facilitate collaboration between the MBSE users and the tool development team to communicate modeling needs and help innovate potential solutions. Provide technical advice and guidance to senior managers regarding the creation and implementation of new MBSE methods and techniques. Required Skills: Requires 0 to 5 years with BS/BA or 2 to 3 years with MS/MA Must have a current and active TS/SCI with CI Polygraph. BS in Engineering, Systems Engineeing, Aeronautical Engineering, Physics, Computer Science, or related STEM degree. Should possess the skills and/or the desire to learn the skills necessary to use industry MBSE tools and modeling methodologies to successfully produce systems engineering models, such as NoMagic Cameo. Experience with systems engineering processes in support of system development life cycle development is a plus. Demonstrated knowledge and/or the desire to learn practical application of UML / SysML modeling languages and experience applying this common structure to an MBSE solution. Entry level knowledge of architecture, requirements engineering, CONOPS development, verification, test, and system integration to accommodate End to End Systems Engineering. Strong communication skills especially with tools developers and customers. Desired Skills : Knowledge or demonstrated experience with DoDAF, UPDM and/or UAF Object Certified Systems Modeler Professional (OCSMP) certification Solvarus employment relationships are made without regard to age, race, color, religion, creed, sex, national origin, marital status, veteran status, the presence of any physical or mental disability, genetic information or any other status or characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law. Discrimination or harassment based upon any of these factors is wholly inconsistent with our company values. If you enjoy working in a fast-paced environment and being on the cutting edge of innovative digital communications technology, this is the place for you. Ability to travel both CONUS and OCONUS, as needed. Travel time could be up to 25%. PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS / SKILLS Understanding of digital data RF systems or data links, and their employment. Experience with Python scripting. Experience working with both the Windows and Linux operating systems. Experience with software and/or hardware testing. Development of automated test tools or test fixtures. Possess a current and active Top Secret security clearance with SCI Eligibility. RESPOSIBILITIES Assist the ADTL management to design, construct, and support test equipment and systems. Develop and maintain ADTL test support hardware, software, and scripts in compliance with established security guidelines. Hands on integration, operation, and maintenance of hardware and electrical components, including using electrical measurement tools for verification and validation. Analyze failures associated with test equipment and provide recommended solutions. Assist Test Engineers with design and development of test architectures and solutions. Review Technical documentation to gather data on which systems will be designed and supported. Interface with program offices in developing engineering solutions. Assist test teams with integration of engineered solutions into test plans, concept of operations, test cards, data-analysis plans, and formal reports. Develop and maintain a comprehensive library and/or continuity database for engineering solutions. Develop and present briefings to test community, program office and senior-level personnel on proposed or operational engineered solutions. Travel to contractors' facilities, test sites, and other locations . Participate in planning, execution, data analysis, report generation, etc., of program-related activities. Support any additional activities as assigned by TGBC leadership. (SPA) delivers high-impact, technical solutions to complex national security issues. With over 50 years of business expertise and consistent growth, we are known for continuous innovation for our government customers, in both the US and abroad. Our exceptionally talented team is highly collaborative in spirit and practice, producing Results that Matter . Come work with the best! We offer opportunity, unique challenges, and clear-sighted commitment to the mission. SPA: Objective. Responsive. Trusted. SPA’s Sea Land Air (SLA) Division supports a diverse portfolio of national security government clients, including the Undersea Enterprise, the Navy Surface Community, the Navy MPTE Enterprise, the Air Force, Army, DoW Agencies, DARPA, international clients including the Canadian Navy and Australian Defence Force. Our primary objective is to provide timely, objective and analytic assessments that integrate the policy, operational, technical, programmatic and acquisition aspects of our clients’ challenges. Leveraging both in-domain and cross-domain expertise to maximize our clients’ success, SLA Division acts as trusted agents to senior decision-makers and key leaders and excels at providing data driven analytic insights, systems engineering, strategies and plans that address current and emerging challenges to national security. SPA’s Operations Research and C5ISR Analysis (ORCA) Group develops and employs simulation system products in support of operations, experimentation, and the acquisition analysis process. ORCA analysts and engineers apply Model-Based System Engineering (MBSE) principles and use commercial and proprietary modeling and simulation tools to evaluate warfighting effectiveness and provide recommendations for investments to solve real-world problems. Candidates must be able to work independently and as part of a team; training will be provided. #KS Responsibilities The ORCA group is seeking a talented Associate Systems Engineer to join our growing team. The successful candidate will participate in project teams to: Assist in the analysis of the performance of DoW programs and systems. Conduct data collection and specification reviews. Assist in the design and develop system-of-systems models using commercial and proprietary MBSE tools and execute modeling and simulation analysis. Perform post-processing data analysis and interpretation. Assist in the preparation of deliverables to include presentations and written reports of findings and recommendations. Participate in customer meetings and briefings. Qualifications Required: Bachelor’s level degree in an Engineering discipline from an accredited university Ability to work full-time on-site in San Diego, CA at SPA and Client sites 0 to 3 years professional experience Ability to obtain and maintain a DoW Top Secret clearance with SCI access Desired: Data analysis experience using modeling and simulation (M S) tools via academia, industry, government, or military service Ability to demonstrate effective written and verbal communication and presentation skills; a short technical presentation will be part of the interview process Ability to be collaborate within and across project teams Ability to develop and apply logical and methodical analytic approaches to problem solving Familiarity or experience with commercial MBSE tools (e.g. Cameo, MagicDraw, Sparks EA) Active DoW Top Secret clearance with SCI eligibility Pay Range Information At SPA, we strive to deliver a robust total compensation package that will attract and retain top talent. 9f90544f-0c83-436c-bf21-faccf96d53fd.title: Senior Automation Engineer - Platform Biology
9f90544f-0c83-436c-bf21-faccf96d53fd.description: <p>What if you could join a rapidly growing company and play a critical role in bringing new medicines to patients by helping scale the programmable infrastructure behind a new human cellular biology platform?</p> <h3>About Vesalius</h3> <p>Vesalius Therapeutics is pioneering a new platform to generate breakthrough treatments for common diseases. Our platform combines large-scale human genetics, genomics, stem cell studies, high-dimensional cellular phenotyping, and artificial intelligence to uncover causal biology and identify optimal intervention points for new therapies. Vesalius was founded in 2019 by Flagship Pioneering.</p> <h3>Role Overview</h3> <p>Vesalius is seeking a highly motivated Automation Engineer to help scale our automated biology platform. This early-career role sits at the intersection of biology, robotics, software, and data systems, with a focus on programming, data handling, systems integration, and workflow automation. nbsp;You will partner with scientists, automation operators, IT, and data science teams to translate biological workflows into robust automated workcells and ensure experiments generate reliable, traceable, analysis-ready data. This role goes beyond operating instruments—it is focused on making automation programmable, integrated, scalable, and reliable.</p> <h3>Key Responsibilities</h3> <ul> <li>Develop and optimize high-throughput automated protocols that translate biological workflows from the bench to integrated workcells.</li> <li>Partner with scientific teams to design automation solutions that balance biological fidelity, throughput, cost, reliability, and lead time.</li> <li>Collaborate with scientists and automation operators on workflow execution, troubleshooting, training, and continuous improvement.</li> <li>Develop and maintain automation scripts, scheduling workflows, error handling, monitoring, and instrument-control methods using tools such as Python, C#, JSON, platform APIs, and vendor-specific languages.</li> <li>Validate automated workflows against benchtop methods, assessing precision, accuracy, reproducibility, and data quality.</li> <li>Build integrations between automation platforms, instruments, LIMS/ELN, imaging systems, databases, and downstream data pipelines, including structured metadata capture and data handoff.</li> <li>Integrate and troubleshoot new instruments and workcell components, including instrument interfaces or drivers where needed.</li> <li>Apply sound software engineering practices including version control, testing, debugging, modular design, and documentation.</li> <li>Program liquid-handling and robotic workflows across platforms such as Hamilton STAR, Dynamic Devices Lynx, HighRes Biosolutions/Cellario, and similar systems.</li> <li>Develop barcode to workflow mapping to enable batch and sample tracking.</li> <li>Create and maintain SOPs, method documentation, validation reports, troubleshooting guides, and other technical documentation.</li> </ul> <h3>Qualifications</h3> <ul> <li>Bachelor s or master s degree in computer science, engineering, bioengineering, automation, robotics, biomedical engineering, computational biology, or related field.</li> <li>Early career experience in laboratory automation, scientific software, robotics, biotech automation, or a related environment.</li> <li>Experience with biological workflows such as mammalian cell culture, cell-based assays, high-content imaging, high-throughput screening, NGS, or iPSC systems is strongly preferred.</li> <li>Hands-on experience with automated liquid handlers, robotic systems, integrated workcells, laboratory scheduling software, or instrument-control methods.</li> <li>Experience developing and troubleshooting automated biological workflows, liquid-handling methods, instrument workflows, software tools, or systems integrations.</li> <li>Ability to troubleshoot across software, hardware, liquid handling, instrument communication, data, and sample-tracking workflows.</li> <li>Programming experience in Python and/or C#, or comparable languages, with familiarity with Git/version control, testing, debugging, and code documentation.</li> <li>Strong communication and documentation skills with the ability to work effectively across scientific, automation, IT, and data teams.</li> </ul> <h3>Preferred Experience</h3> <ul> <li>Exposure to cloud infrastructure such as AWS, event-driven integrations, or data pipelines supporting automated laboratory environments.</li> <li>Experience with Hamilton STAR, Dynamic Devices Lynx, HighRes Biosolutions/Cellario, Beckman Biomek, Tecan, Biosero, Celltrio, Ginkgo Automation RAC systems, or similar platforms.</li> <li>Experience with platform APIs, instrument drivers, SQL/databases, LIMS/ELN, automated metadata capture, or laboratory scheduling software.</li> <li>Experience building tools for sample tracking, run monitoring, QC reporting, workflow validation, or automated data handoff.</li> </ul> <p>At Flagship, we accept impossible missions to enable bigger leaps. Key Responsibilities • Prepare devices under test (DUTs) and printed circuit boards (PCBs) for radiation testing — including soldering, cabling/harnessing, and mounting parts to test fixtures. • Set up, verify, and operate electronics lab and test equipment (oscilloscopes, digital multimeters, power supplies, electronic loads, signal sources). • Execute high dose rate TID testing and single event effects (SEE) testing in accordance with established test plans and procedures. • Travel to and support test campaigns at radiation test facilities, including operating tests during scheduled beam time. • Monitor devices during irradiation, capture and log test data, and document results in detailed, well-organized test records. • Support the development and use of automated test setups and data-acquisition scripts. Preferred Qualifications • Experience with PCB design and layout a plus. • Exposure to or coursework in radiation effects concepts (TID, SEE, SEU, SEL, SEB, SEGR, LET, cross-section, fluence/flux). • Basic programming / scripting for test automation and instrument control (e.g., Python, LabVIEW, GPIB/SCPI). • Experience programming or exercising microcontrollers or FPGAs to operate a DUT during testing. • Familiarity with relevant test standards (e.g., MIL-STD-883 Method 1019 for TID; ASTM F1192 / JESD57 for SEE). • Experience with device decapsulation / delidding or other die-exposure techniques. • Prior experience in aerospace, defense, space, or high-reliability electronics environments. Travel Schedule • Ability to travel on approximately 8 trips per year with a typical duration of 6–10 days per trip. Will require odd work hours including overnight and weekends. • Beam time at radiation test facilities is scheduled around the clock and is costly and limited, so testing often runs continuously — flexibility and stamina during these campaigns are essential. Physical Requirements • Ability to lift and transport test equipment and shipping cases (up to ~50 lbs) and to set up equipment at off-site facilities. • Comfortable working in laboratory, cleanroom, and accelerator / beamline environments. Complete required pre-test equipment checks, system verifications, and equipment-status reviews. Laboratory maintenance, quality, and safety – 10% Maintain laboratory organization, equipment, cables, accessories, tools, fixtures, and test areas. b8303f31-8c50-46eb-80e0-a9af9324ba88.description: Join the CrowdGen team as an Independent Contractor for Project Athabasca! We are currently looking for thoughtful and introspective Independent Contractors to help evaluate whether AI systems truly understand people. In this role, contributors will review personalized questions and checklists about themselves and answer honestly based on their own experiences and preferences. Your responses will help improve AI-powered recommendation systems. Requirements: - Have a personal Instagram account - Be comfortable sharing your personal user history from Facebook and Instagram with our client - Have education or professional experience in fields such as counseling, psychology, or other fields where people are more likely to be introspective - Be comfortable reflecting on and providing honest responses about yourself - Have strong attention to detail and the ability to provide thoughtful, authentic responses Data Privacy: - Contributors will be asked to share personal user history from Facebook and Instagram with our client for the purposes of this project. The data will remain confidential and will only be used to improve the recommendation system. It will not be used for any other purpose. Compensation: - The project rate is $18 per hour This role is a project-based opportunity with CrowdGen, where you will join the CrowdGen Community as an Independent Contractor. If selected, you will receive an email from CrowdGen regarding the creation of an account using your application email address. You will need to log in to this account and reset the password, complete the setup requirements, and proceed with your application for this project-based role. If you are interested in helping improve AI systems and are comfortable providing thoughtful, honest feedback about yourself, we’d love to have you on board. Apply today and become part of the CrowdGen Community for Project Athabasca! #crowdgen

b91d1b8c-98f8-4dad-8b55-0398ca8daac5.title: Flight Software Engineer Development Program - Path to Hire
b91d1b8c-98f8-4dad-8b55-0398ca8daac5.description: <p><strong><span data-contrast= auto ><span data-contrast= none >A New Paradigm For Space Operations.</span></span></strong></p> <div> <div><strong><span data-contrast= auto >Who We Are:</span></strong><span data-ccp-props= { quot;201341983 quot;:0, quot;335559737 quot;:-360, quot;335559739 quot;:0, quot;335559740 quot;:240} > nbsp;</span></div> <div> <p>Space Kinetic is a dual use space technology startup building a completely new architecture for space operations – one that brings the advantages of proliferated drone technology (low-cost, operationally flexible, attritable, distributed) to space missions while reducing the ecosystem s reliance on consumable fuel. In a world where many companies are focused on incrementally improving the status quo, nbsp; we are focused on creating something entirely different – an architecture underpinned by new first principles to meet the opportunities and challenges of the third space age head-on. nbsp;Our goal is to move away from one-to-one space architectures – where each satellite in a constellation has one (or a small # of) primary payloads attached to the bus -- and unlock a ‘one-to-many’ system, where each satellite has a large number of payloads which can be deployed from their host spacecraft at high velocities without firing a thruster.</p> <p><span data-teams= true >This is not a role for someone looking for a traditional 40-hour work week. Space Kinetic is building ambitious, first-of-its-kind technology, and that requires urgency, ownership, and a high level of commitment to changing the foundational assumptions for everything we do in space.</span></p> </div> </div> <div> <p><strong>Our Development Program:</strong></p> <p>This is a full-time, onsite program for three months at our headquarters in El Segundo, California.</p> <p>Our Development Program is a pathway to a career at Space Kinetic. We hire recent graduates who are eager to solve cutting edge technical problems and contribute to high consequence dual use space missions. Interns become part of our core technical, operations, and business teams, work on mission-critical projects, and are evaluated for long-term career opportunities based on performance, initiative, collaboration, and ownership. 65489b2c-dccf-4a4b-b089-0a049511d131.title: Forward-Deployed Engineer - Strategic Accounts
65489b2c-dccf-4a4b-b089-0a049511d131.description: Company Overview Deepgram is the leading platform underpinning the emerging trillion-dollar Voice AI economy, providing real-time APIs for speech-to-text (STT), text-to-speech (TTS), and building production-grade voice agents at scale. More than 200,000 developers and 1,300+ organizations build voice offerings that are ‘Powered by Deepgram’, including Twilio, Cloudflare, Sierra, Decagon, Vapi, Daily, Cresta, Granola, and Jack in the Box. Deepgram’s voice-native foundation models are accessed through cloud APIs or as self-hosted and on-premises software, with unmatched accuracy, low latency, and cost efficiency. Backed by a recent Series C led by leading global investors and strategic partners, Deepgram has processed over 50,000 years of audio and transcribed more than 1 trillion words. There is no organization in the world that understands voice better than Deepgram. Company Operating Rhythm At Deepgram, we expect an AI-first mindset—AI use and comfort aren’t optional, they’re core to how we operate, innovate, and measure performance. Every team member who works at Deepgram is expected to actively use and experiment with advanced AI tools, and even build your own into your everyday work. We measure how effectively AI is applied to deliver results, and consistent, creative use of the latest AI capabilities is key to success here. Candidates should be comfortable adopting new models and modes quickly, integrating AI into their workflows, and continuously pushing the boundaries of what these technologies can do. Additionally, we move at the pace of AI. Change is rapid, and you can expect your day-to-day work to evolve just as quickly. This may not be the right role if you’re not excited to experiment, adapt, think on your feet, and learn constantly, or if you’re seeking something highly prescriptive with a traditional 9-to-5. The Opportunity Most engineering roles ask you to build the platform. This one asks you to build everything between the platform and a customer's success: the solutions, integrations, and tooling that run in production for some of the largest enterprises in the world. Deepgram is seeking Forward-Deployed Engineers for our strategic accounts. You'll embed with one strategic customer at a time, working directly with their technical and business teams, alongside Deepgram's core research teams. Today's engagements center on leading restaurant enterprises and restaurant technology partners (we already partner with several of the world's leading restaurant brands), and the examples in this posting come from that work. As a Forward-Deployed Engineer, you'll take Deepgram's voice AI platform the last mile. That means production-scale integrations with the systems that your customer actually runs on (today, that's point of sale, loyalty, payment gateways, and customer data platforms), voice agents that take live orders from customers every day, and everything in between: the tooling, prompt engineering, and evaluation work that bridges what Deepgram offers today and what makes your customer successful tomorrow. Forward-deployed means you do this work with your customer, not just for them. You'll be on site regularly, embedded with their technical team, and close enough to the business to see problems before they become escalations. You'll also have a senior Forward-Deployed Engineer alongside you, reviewing your work before it ships and bringing you into customer meetings. And the platform is not a fixed product that you implement. When your customer needs a capability that the platform does not offer yet, you'll be the one who proves what it should do next, and what you build and learn in the field becomes part of Deepgram's offering for every customer after yours. About Forward-Deployed Engineering at Deepgram Forward-Deployed Engineering is how Deepgram embeds with its most strategic accounts. You'll fully deploy into a dedicated account pod (a small, cross-functional team built around one strategic customer) for a defined stretch, working inside of that account's day to day with a high degree of autonomy. Full deployment means exactly that: while you're deployed, your pod's account is your only customer assignment, with no time split across other accounts or teams. Your work directly shapes how some of the world's largest brands put voice AI in front of their customers. Forward-Deployed Engineers are part of our broader Applied Engineering team, which serves as the technical interface between Deepgram and our customers across their entire journey (it combines what other companies split into Forward-Deployed Engineering, Sales Engineering, Solutions Architecture, Implementation, and Technical Support). Applied Engineering is your home team and your growth path. You'll be hired into the Applied Engineer position, which has a single growth ladder from Associate through Principal, and you'll grow proficient across multiple roles over time. The pod is where you're deployed; Applied Engineering is where you grow. What You'll Do Build and ship whatever the solution needs, whether that's an end-to-end service, an integration, internal tooling, or agent and prompt engineering Design, develop, and maintain production-scale integrations with the third-party systems that your customer runs on (in today's pods: point of sale, loyalty, payment gateways, customer data platforms) Spend regular time on site with your customer, working directly with their technical and business teams Monitor, debug, and optimize what you ship in production, including some of the hardest audio environments in voice AI (noisy, multi-mic, drive-thru) Work with our research and product teams to push the platform where your customer needs it to go, and feed what you learn in the field back into the product Test changes against live production data and measure whether they move accuracy, latency, and throughput Time Allocation Embedded customer delivery (60-80%) — Deployments, integrations, and technical problem-s
65489b2c-dccf-4a4b-b089-0a049511d131.fit_reason: Real engineering work on production voice-AI integrations, agents, and prompt/eval tooling touches the candidate's AI/agentic + backend microservices strengths, but it's a customer-embedded forward-deployed/solutions role (heavy on-site time, POS/loyalty/payments integrations, account-facing delivery) rather than the backend/distributed-systems or platform-infra work he's optimized for, and the Associate–Principal Applied Engineering ladder skews toward candidates with prior enterprise-facing experience.

Deepgram is a well-funded Series C AI infrastructure company hiring in SF/NYC, which typically means competitive-but-not-FAANG cash plus meaningful illiquid equity. Entry-level/Associate Applied Engineer base likely ~$130–160k with a modest bonus and startup options; FDE roles at AI companies often carry a slight premium over standard SWE for the travel and customer exposure. Band is wide because Deepgram doesn't publish new-grad levels and equity value is speculative — cash-only TC could land nearer $135–150k, comfortably above the candidate's ~$130k anchor.

This goes for the emissions-free Electric Adventure Vehicles we build, and the curious, courageous souls we seek to attract. As a company, we constantly challenge what’s possible, never simply accepting what has always been done. We reframe old problems, seek new solutions and operate comfortably in areas that are unknown. Our backgrounds are diverse, but our team shares a love of the outdoors and a desire to protect it for future generations. Role Summary Rivian is looking for a Software Engineer to help build the internal products and platforms that make cloud and software spend more visible, efficient, and accountable. On the Cloud Software FinOps team, you will work with experienced engineers and business partners to design, build, test, and operate software that manages Rivian’s application portfolio, optimizes cloud costs, and supports future FinOps capabilities. This is a hands-on role with opportunities across backend services, data pipelines, cloud automation, and full-stack internal products. You will turn real business and engineering problems into practical tools used by teams across Rivian. The role is a strong fit for someone who enjoys learning quickly, writing maintainable software, understanding how technology decisions affect cost and value, and seeing their work create measurable business impact. This role will be located in Atlanta, GA and report to our Director, Cloud Software FinOps. Responsibilities Build and enhance internal software for application portfolio management, cloud cost optimization, and software efficiency. Develop backend services, APIs, integrations, and data pipelines that connect cloud cost, usage, resource, application, ownership, and portfolio data. Create dashboards and workflows that help engineers, technology leaders, Finance, Procurement, and application owners make informed decisions. Contribute to system design, database design, and infrastructure decisions, balancing scalability, reliability, security, usability, and cost. Use approved AI coding agents for implementation, testing, refactoring, and documentation; read, review, test, and debug the resulting code. Build secure, observable services using CI/CD, infrastructure-as-code, logging, metrics, and tracing. Partner with Cloud Engineering, Finance, Procurement, Security, application teams, and other stakeholders to turn business problems into practical solutions. Troubleshoot issues, document technical decisions and operating procedures, and continuously improve the team’s products and processes. Qualifications A bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical field. Experience building software through coursework, internships, co-ops, research, personal projects, or prior employment; no specific number of years of professional experience is required. Experience with Python and/or TypeScript and the ability to read, review, test, and discuss code. Strong fundamentals in another modern programming language will also be considered. Foundational knowledge of system design, database design, cloud infrastructure, and the tradeoffs involved in building reliable services. Experience writing SQL and working with structured data, relational databases, data models, or data pipelines. An understanding of HTTP, REST APIs, data exchange formats, and service-to-service integrations. Familiarity with cloud computing concepts and at least one major cloud platform. Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills, along with a willingness to seek guidance and take increasing ownership. Pay Disclosure The salary range for this role is $97,700 - $122,100 for Georgia based applicants. This is the lowest to highest salary we in good faith believe we would pay for this role at the time of this posting. An employee’s position within the salary range will be based on several factors including, but not limited to, specific competencies, relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, geographic location, shift, and organizational needs. The successful candidate may be eligible for annual performance bonus and equity awards. We offer a comprehensive package of benefits for full-time and part-time employees, their spouse or domestic partner, and children up to age 26, including but not limited to paid vacation, paid sick leave, and a competitive portfolio of insurance benefits including life, medical, dental, vision, short-term disability insurance, and long-term disability insurance to eligible employees. You may also have the opportunity to participate in Rivian’s 401(k) Plan and Employee Stock Purchase Program if you meet certain eligibility requirements. Full-time employee coverage is effective on their first day of employment. Part-time employee coverage is effective the first of the month following 90 days of employment. 238b4335-e95e-471b-ad55-a3d3da60a5f6.title: Associate Software Engineer
238b4335-e95e-471b-ad55-a3d3da60a5f6.description: <div class= content-intro ><h2><strong>What you’ll be part of</strong></h2> <p>Garner is on a mission to transform the U.S. healthcare system — and we’re the only proven player doing exactly that. We partner with employers to redesign how healthcare works: applying 550+ proprietary clinical metrics across 80+ specialties to a dataset of 320M+ patients to identify the best-performing doctors, then using compelling incentives to steer members to the care that helps them get healthier, faster.</p> <p>The result is a rare “win win” — better care and lower costs for both members and employers. In just five years, our work has helped over 2.5 million people access higher-quality care and saved $1B in healthcare costs. We recently raised our Series E and have doubled five years running. If you ve ever wanted your work to solve a problem that touches every person in this country, this is the opportunity to do exactly that. You d be joining a team fundamentally reimagining healthcare in the U.S. — and using AI to scale that impact further and faster than anyone else can.</p></div><h2><strong>Who we want</strong></h2> <p>This is a role for someone who wants to work on a hard problem, deliver real impact and be pushed to be the best version of themselves. As an Associate Software Engineer, you’ll be embedded in our Engineering organization.</p> <p>Garner’s Engineering team tackles incredibly hard technical problems for a mission that truly matters. Our systems analyze billions of medical records to rank healthcare providers across the country. We expect our engineers to champion cutting-edge industry practices as we aggressively embrace AI in every facet of our operations and norms. We are seeking teammates who take pride in doing great work and stay curious about new techniques and technologies.</p> <h2><strong>What you will do</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Use AI to build, optimize, and maintain software systems</li> <li>Collaborate across disciplines to understand our users and iterate on new ideas</li> <li>Protect our users’ privacy and security through secure coding practices</li> <li>Participate in code reviews, sharing your insights and learning from others</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What we re looking for</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Recent graduate (Spring 2026) or currently enrolled student (expected graduation of Fall 2026 or Spring 2027), with a Bachelor s or Master s in Computer Science or a related STEM field</li> <li>Solid CS fundamentals with experience in front-end (JavaScript, React) or back-end (Python, Node.js) technologies</li> <li>Experience with a database system such as PostgreSQL or ElasticSearch; familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, Docker) is a plus</li> <li>Exposure to building with AI coding agents (we use Claude Code) is a plus</li> <li>A track record of shipping high-quality features through internships or personal projects</li> <li>Strong technical writing, analytical, and communication skills</li> <li>Excited to join a high-performing, mission-driven team that values urgency, accountability, and honest feedback</li> <li>A desire to do work that matters: and to be held to a high standard while doing it. You re energized by a mission with measurable outcomes, not just good intentions. You engage with AI tools as part of how you do your best work, and hold yourself accountable to outcomes that matter beyond your team’s metrics</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you’ll get here</strong></h2> <p>You’ll work on problems that matter, at a company working to change healthcare at scale. You’ll work at the intersection of AI and systemic healthcare reform, where the problems we solve are as interesting and compelling as the mission.</p> <p>At Garner, you’ll take on real, ambitious problems with real ownership and autonomy, alongside exceptional, principles-based people who genuinely want you to win. It’s demanding by design. You’ll be challenged to stretch beyond what you thought possible and receive consistent coaching to help you grow and do the best work of your career. This isn t the right fit for everyone, and that s intentional. The people here are driven by what s at stake for real people, and that s what gives our intensity its purpose. nbsp;</p> <h2><strong>Technologies we use</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Claude Code, Kubernetes, AWS, Airflow, dlt, dbt, Python, TypeScript, React, Go</li> </ul> <p>Please note: we are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment visa at this time.</p> <h2><strong>Compensation</strong></h2> <p>The target base comp range for this role is $150,000. Individual compensation will depend on qualifications, skills, and applicable laws.</p> <p>In addition to base compensation, this role is eligible to participate in our equity incentive plan and benefits package, including: flexible PTO, Medical/Dental/Vision plan options, 401(k) with company match, flexible spending accounts, Teladoc Health, and more.</p> <p><em>Few roles offer this combination: work that is genuinely hard, a mission that is genuinely important, and a team that is genuinely invested in your success. If that’s what you’re looking for, we’d love to meet you.</em></p><div class= content-conclusion ><div> <h3><strong>Fraud and Security Notice: nbsp;</strong></h3> <p>Please be aware of recent job scam attempts. Our recruiters use <a href= http://getgarner.com/ >getgarner.com</a> and <a href= garnerhealth.com >garnerhealth.com</a> email

097cd79f-8c8e-447c-aa2f-7f8ffbccbba9.title: Forward Deployed AI Analyst
097cd79f-8c8e-447c-aa2f-7f8ffbccbba9.description: Makai Labs builds AI systems that automate real work inside companies. As a Forward Deployed AI Analyst, you will train with Makai’s engineering, product, and client teams, then embed in one of our client engagements to find the workflows worth automating and build AI agents that handle them. You will work directly with the people who run the business, and your work is done when their teams rely on what you built. This is an early-career role. You will see how a company actually runs from the inside, rapidly become a subject matter expert, and iterate on prototypes to improve their workflows. Responsibilities You will spend about your first month in training and shadowing, then take one workflow end to end alongside a Makai lead before working more independently. Engagements vary, but most follow the same arc. You start by learning how the work is done today. Discovery tasks include interviewing client Subject Matter Experts (SMEs), reading the documents they work from, and mapping the systems involved. Based on this discovery, you propose what to automate, work with the client team to write the spec, and build a prototype on Makai's platform. Makai engineers support the technical work throughout. If the prototype holds up with client practitioners, you run the rollout and measure productivity and ROI. Not every project reaches every stage. Some end at discovery, and some prototypes don't survive user testing. Part of the job is figuring out what won’t work, so that we can focus our effort optimally. Over time, Analysts will get put onto career development tracks toward AI engineering, product and implementation, or engagement leadership, depending on performance and interest. Example Problems A finance team spends days manually reading data from PDFs, entering them into giant spreadsheets, running internal formulae and drafting reports based on these results. A field operations team spends hours manually scheduling and resolving conflicts for employees using multiple disconnected platforms. A spreadsheet process has become a business-critical system without clear ownership or controls. Qualifications We are looking for seniors, recent graduates, and early-career candidates who want a path toward company leadership. An ideal candidate has shown ownership both inside and outside the classroom. That could mean you: Built a product, tool, model, startup, research system, or internal process. We strive to help achieve personal career goals by providing opportunities of growth and movement throughout the company. Job Description The AI Solutions Analyst I helps build, deploy, and continuously improve AI-powered data solutions that enable employees to ask business questions and perform ad hoc analysis using natural language. Working closely with the Data Warehousing team and business stakeholders, this role configures and optimizes AI agents within Snowflake, translates business requirements into effective agent experiences, tests and evaluates agent performance, and improves the quality and usefulness of agent responses over time. This is an early-career technical analytics role at the intersection of data, artificial intelligence, and business enablement. Its primary focus is making enterprise AI agents accurate, useful, reliable, governed, and accessible to business users rather than developing production software or owning core data warehouse models. Work location: This position is based at doTERRA's Pleasant Grove, Utah campus and requires full-time, on-site presence. Job Responsibilities AI Agent Development Configuration Build and configure internal AI agents that help employees interact with approved enterprise data through natural language. Define and refine agent instructions, context, tools, workflows, guardrails, and expected response behaviors. Configure agents to use approved Snowflake data assets, Cortex Analyst semantic views, and other governed resources as appropriate. Create and maintain evaluation sets that include representative questions, expected outcomes, edge cases, and known limitations. Diagnose inaccurate, incomplete, unsupported, or inconsistent responses and iterate on configurations to improve results. Evaluate emerging Snowflake AI and agent capabilities and recommend where they can strengthen doTERRA's internal AI ecosystem. Agent Quality Continuous Improvement Establish repeatable methods for evaluating response correctness, relevance, groundedness, consistency, reliability, and usability. Review agent interactions, evaluation results, and user feedback to identify recurring failure patterns and improvement opportunities. Test and document changes to instructions, tools, and configurations before broader deployment. Partner with Data Warehousing team members when agent performance reveals gaps in source data, business definitions, semantic resources, or access patterns. Help develop standards, documentation, and lifecycle practices for creating, releasing, monitoring, and maintaining enterprise AI agents. Follow applicable data governance, security, privacy, and responsible AI requirements, escalating risks or control gaps when identified. Business Requirements Solution Design Meet with business leaders and end users to understand common questions, workflows, terminology, metrics, and decision-making needs. Translate business requirements into clear agent use cases, acceptance criteria, representative questions, and expected behaviors. Identify which questions and workflows are appropriate for AI-enabled self-service analytics and clarify boundaries for out-of-scope or higher-risk requests. Work with technical partners to confirm that required data is available, governed, defined consistently, and structured for the intended use case. Validate solutions with business stakeholders and incorporate their feedback into prioritized improvements. Adoption Enablement Support the rollout of AI agents across business functions through pilots, demonstrations, training, and practical usage guidance. Help users learn how to ask effective questions, interpret results, and recognize when additional validation is needed. Document agent capabilities, limitations, intended use cases, data coverage, and known behaviors in clear language. Gather structured feedback, maintain an improvement backlog, track adoption, and identify opportunities to reduce manual analysis or improve access to information Job Qualifications Required Bachelor's degree in Business Analytics, Information Systems, Data Analytics, Computer Science, Finance, Accounting, or another related analytical field. Foundational understanding of relational data, databases, metrics, and analytical concepts, with the ability to translate business questions into structured requirements and testable expected outcomes. Hands-on experience with generative AI, AI agents, LLM-based workflows, or related technologies through employment, internships, academic work, or substantial personal projects. Strong analytical, problem-solving, troubleshooting, and attention-to-detail skills, together with the curiosity to experiment, test, learn, and iterate. Strong written and verbal communication skills and the ability to work independently and collaboratively with technical teams, business stakeholders, and end users. Preferred Experience with Snowflake and Snowflake Cortex, including Cortex Agents, Cortex Analyst, Cortex Search, or related capabilities. Experience configuring, testing, monitoring, or evaluating AI agents, with familiarity in prompt and instruction design, orchestration, semantic layers or views, or retrieval-based AI systems. Working knowledge of SQL and relational databases; familiarity with tools such as Python, Git, or VS Code is a plus. Experience with business intelligence or data visualization tools such as Tableau or Power BI. Experience designing evaluations or testing the accuracy and reliability of AI-generated results.
