6c3fb746-2d33-44e9-b97d-ada170e96ef0.title: Software Engineer 1
6c3fb746-2d33-44e9-b97d-ada170e96ef0.description: About AiPrise AiPrise is a global compliance orchestration platform helping fintechs, marketplaces, and payment companies verify and onboard customers worldwide. We integrate with 80+ identity and compliance vendors to deliver a holistic view of risk. We're now building AI-powered compliance agents to revolutionize KYB, AML, sanctions screening, and risk scoring — enabling our customers to onboard faster, reduce manual reviews, and prevent financial crime. Role Overview We’re hiring a Software Engineer I to help build and scale the core platform behind AiPrise’s compliance orchestration and AI agent systems. This is a build it, ship it, own it role. You’ll take features end to end, from design to code to deploy to iterate, across our case management product, vendor integrations, orchestration APIs, and customer facing tools. You’ll be in the trenches with founders and a fast moving team, turning messy real world compliance problems into clean, reliable systems. If you’re a hungry engineer who wants real ownership, high impact, and a product that gets used in production every day, you’ll love this. What You'll Do Build Own Features End-to-End Design, develop, and ship production features across our platform stack (backend APIs, data pipelines, integrations, case management UI) Own complete features from requirements gathering → implementation → deployment → monitoring Build scalable REST APIs and microservices that orchestrate checks across 80+ compliance vendors (identity verification, sanctions screening, document analysis) Develop case management workflows and business logic for KYB/AML compliance processes Create data pipelines for ingesting, transforming, and routing compliance data at scale Integrate with third-party identity/compliance APIs and handle complex vendor response mapping Drive Technical Excellence Write clean, maintainable, well-tested code with comprehensive documentation Participate in code reviews and contribute to engineering best practices Debug production issues with urgency; own incident resolution end-to-end Optimize system performance, reliability, and cost-efficiency Build monitoring, alerting, and observability into your features Collaborate Work cross-functionally with product managers, compliance experts, and customer success teams Contribute to technical decision-making and architecture discussions Help shape engineering culture and development workflows as the team scales What We're Looking For Must-Have: 0-2 years of professional software engineering experience building and shipping production systems Strong programming fundamentals in at least one modern backend language (Python, Go, Java, Node.js, or similar) Experience building RESTful APIs, microservices, or distributed systems Solid understanding of relational databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL) and data modeling Familiarity with Git, CI/CD pipelines, Docker, and modern deployment practices Strong debugging and problem-solving skills; comfortable working in unfamiliar codebases Excellent communication skills and ability to translate business needs into technical solutions Nice-to-Have: Experience in FinTech, RegTech, payments, or fraud/risk detection domains Knowledge of compliance workflows (KYC/KYB, AML, sanctions screening, adverse media) Experience with event-driven architectures and message queues (Kafka, RabbitMQ, AWS SQS) Familiarity with NoSQL databases (MongoDB, DynamoDB) or search engines (Elasticsearch) Experience integrating with third-party APIs and managing vendor relationships at scale Frontend development experience (React, TypeScript) for building internal tools Background working with ML/AI systems or data-intensive applications Kubernetes, Terraform, or infrastructure-as-code experience Why AiPrise Build mission-critical software that directly fights financial crime and fraud for companies like Meta and leading fintechs Work with diverse, complex datasets from 200+ countries Join a fast-moving YC-backed startup where your work has immediate customer impact Ship quickly — your code will reach production in days, not months Join in-person with a talented, mission-driven team in San Jose Competitive compensation with meaningful equity upside About the interview Remote: Exploratory Discussion (includes a DSA) In-office DSA/Problem Solving Coding Assessment System Design Interview DSA/Problem Solving Coding Assessment Technical and Cultural Fit Compensation Discussion
6c3fb746-2d33-44e9-b97d-ada170e96ef0.fit_reason: Strong technical overlap — backend REST APIs/microservices, Postgres data modeling, data pipelines, Docker/CI-CD, Kubernetes/Terraform, and AI-agent work all map directly onto the candidate's Java/Python/Rust backend and AI-infra profile — but it's a small YC startup hiring "0-2 years professional experience" for an immediate in-person San Jose start, which clashes with a May 2027 grad date and the Boston/NYC/remote preference.
6c3fb746-2d33-44e9-b97d-ada170e96ef0.tc_basis: Low-confidence, wide band: AiPrise is an early-stage (YC-backed, roughly seed/Series A) startup with no public new-grad comp data. Estimate is anchored on Bay Area early-stage SWE I norms — base roughly $120-155k plus a small bonus and illiquid equity that startups quote at high paper value. Cash-only TC likely sits nearer the $125-150k end; the top of the band assumes generous equity valuation, so realistically this is at or slightly above the candidate's ~$130k target but below the $165k ceiling on a cash basis, and the equity portion carries real risk.

9fad232c-43cc-403b-9475-b965f64e9c1f.title: Product Staff Engineer
9fad232c-43cc-403b-9475-b965f64e9c1f.description: Coding was first. Recruiting is next — and we're building it. We are an applied AI lab building end-to-end recruiting agents that feel like coworkers. Metaview helps organizations hire with radically more speed and precision. We automate toil and augment humans for some of the world’s most ambitious recruiting teams. Hear directly from our customers . Founded by Siadhal Magos and Shahriar Tajbakhsh, who scaled Uber and Palantir, we have raised over $50M from top-tier investors. We are growing 5x year over year, our customers are raving fans of the product, and our story has been covered in Fortune, Forbes, TechCrunch, and The Times. Now is the time to re-engineer how work gets done with AI at the core, and our toughest challenges still lie ahead. We are looking for people seeking the hardest, most fulfilling work of their lives. We have one value: velocity. Not motion for its own sake, but real progress. We ship every day, ship on Fridays, and skip the tickets, roadmaps, and design-doc theater. We barely write code by hand anymore: every engineer orchestrates a stack of agents, and we ship 8x what we did a year ago with the same small team. Process stays light, standards stay high, and feedback loops stay short. What you'll build Day to day, you'll work on: new product experiences across the hiring workflow systems that turn conversational signal into structured actions and insights AI-assisted features that need to feel useful, transparent, and well-integrated into the product improvements to quality, speed, and reliability across both user-facing and agent-facing parts of the product product problems that cut across engineering, design, product, and go-to-market context What you'll own In your first 3-6 months, you should: own and ship meaningful product areas from problem definition through rollout help shape how Metaview's AI products behave in real customer workflows identify and drive improvements that make the product faster, clearer, and more valuable contribute to the engineering bar across craft, execution, and product judgment What we're after We're hiring across all levels , but we are excited by people who: have shipped product in fast-moving software environments are comfortable working across the stack, or moving outside their default lane when needed care deeply about users and can translate messy problems into clear product decisions combine technical strength with product sense and good judgment like ownership, ambiguity, and close collaboration across functions want to help build a category-defining product while the shape of the company is still being formed What you bring Helpful signals include experience with: shipping products, workflow software, or AI-enabled products systems where frontend and backend decisions meaningfully shape each other building products used in consequential or trust-sensitive moments startup or scale-up environments where iteration speed and ownership are both high What you want to know A small, sharp, in-person team in San Francisco. Best ideas win on merit, not ceremony. Want to know what it's actually like? Read our unfiltered Slack at metaview.ai/careers#slackbook . We pay in the top 10% of the SF market — salary and meaningful equity. Our process is fast and direct. It's not unusual to hear back the same day. We operate with a simplified leveling, early-career, mid-career, and staff and above. Your level sets your comp. No back-and-forth, no games. We track the market closely and adjust when it tells us to. Market refreshers, twice a year. We re-benchmark against the market two times a year and move comp up when it drifts — so "top 10%" stays true, not just true on your start date. Promotions and raises on a real cycle. We review level and scope roughly every six months. When your responsibilities grow, your comp follows. It's tied to a real change in the work rather than an automatic bump. Equity that's genuinely competitive. World-class equity option grants so we’re all owners. We keep the structure simple: cash and equity. Visa sponsorship and immigration support. We sponsor work visas and handle the process with you, start to finish. Health, fully covered (US). 100% of medical, dental, and vision premiums — for you and your dependents. Time off, unlimited. You should feel empowered to take as much time off as you need.
9fad232c-43cc-403b-9475-b965f64e9c1f.fit_reason: Titled a Staff role at a small in-person SF startup that wants shipped-product track record and product judgment across the full stack — off-profile for a 2027 new grad whose depth is backend/distributed systems, though the "hiring across all levels" note and early-career band keep it from being a hard zero.
9fad232c-43cc-403b-9475-b965f64e9c1f.tc_basis: Well-funded SF applied-AI startup ($50M+ raised, 5x YoY growth) that explicitly claims to pay in the top 10% of the SF market with meaningful equity and an "early-career" leveling band. No public new-grad data for Metaview, so this is a wide inferred band based on comparable Series A/B SF AI startups paying top-of-market: roughly $150-185k base plus equity for an early-career hire. Note the posting itself is for the Staff band, where comp would be materially higher (~$250k+), but the estimate below is for the new-grad/early-career level the candidate would actually enter at.
